quotes.quote: The meaning of things lies not in the things themselves but in our attitude toward them.

quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
quotes.quote: The notion of looking on at life has always been hateful to me. What am I if I am not a participant? In order to be, I must participate.

quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
quotes.quote: The seed haunted by the sun never fails to find its way between the stones in the ground. And the pure logician, if no sun draws him forth, remains entangled in his logic.

quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
quotes.quote: The thing that is important is the thing that is not seen.

quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
quotes.quote: There is no liberty except the liberty of some one making his way towards something. Such a man can be set free if you will teach him the meaning of thirst, and how to trace a path to a well. Only then will he embark upon a course of action that will not be without significance. You could not liberate a stone if there were no law of gravity - for where will the stone go, once it is quarried?

quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
quotes.quote: To be a man is to be responsible: to be ashamed of miseries you did not cause; to be proud of your comrades' victories; to be aware, when setting one stone, that you are building a world.

quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
quotes.quote: To give you an idea of the size of the Earth, I will tell you that before the invention of electricity it was necessary to maintain, over the whole of the six continents, a veritable army of 462,511 lamplighters for the street lamps.

quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
quotes.quote: Transport of the mails, transport of the human voice, transport of flickering pictures — in this century, as in others, our highest accomplishments still have the single aim of bringing men together.

quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
quotes.quote: Treason implies responsibility for something, control over something, influence upon something, knowledge of something. Treason in our time is a proof of genius. Why, I want to know, are not traitors decorated?

quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
quotes.quote: War is not an adventure. It is a disease. It is like typhus.

quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
quotes.quote: Water, thou hast no taste, no color, no odor; canst not be defined, art relished while ever mysterious. Not necessary to life, but rather life itself, thou fillest us with a gratification that exceeds the delight of the senses.

quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
quotes.quote: We say nothing essential about the cathedral when we speak of its stones. We say nothing essential about Man when we seek to define him by the qualities of men.

quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
quotes.quote: What makes the desert beautiful is that it hides, somewhere, a well.

quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
quotes.quote: When the body sinks into death, the essence of man is revealed. Man is a knot, a web, a mesh into which relationships are tied. Only those relationships matter. The body is an old crock that nobody will miss. I have never known a man to think of himself when dying. Never.

quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
quotes.quote: Your task is not to foresee the future, but to enable it.

quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
quotes.quote: If you want to build a ship, don't drum up people together to collect wood and don't assign them tasks and work, but rather teach them to long for the endless immensity of the sea.

quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
quotes.quote: Freedom and constraint are two aspects of the same necessity, the necessity of being the man you are and not another. You are free to be that man, but not another.

quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
quotes.quote: And now here is my secret, a very simple secret; it is only with the heart that one can see rightly, what is essential is invisible to the eye.

quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
quotes.quote: To live is to be slowly born.

quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
quotes.quote: One sees clearly only with the heart. Anything essential is invisible to the eyes.

quotes.author: Anton Chekhov
quotes.quote: Man is what he believes.

quotes.author: Anton Chekhov
quotes.quote: When people are ashamed they hold aloof, above all from those nearest to them.

quotes.author: Anton Chekhov
quotes.quote: Man will become better only when you will make him see what he is like.

quotes.author: Anton Chekhov
quotes.quote: If in the first act you have hung a pistol on the wall, then in the following one it should be fired. Otherwise don't put it there.

quotes.author: Anton Chekhov
quotes.quote: Love, friendship, respect do not unite people as much as common hatred for something.

quotes.author: Anton Chekhov
quotes.quote: You must trust and believe in people or life becomes impossible.

quotes.author: Anton Chekhov
quotes.quote: An artist observes, selects, guesses, and synthesizes.

quotes.author: Anton Chekhov
quotes.quote: He who desires nothing, hopes for nothing, and is afraid of nothing, cannot be an artist.

quotes.author: Anton Chekhov
quotes.quote: One must be a god to be able to tell successes from failures without making a mistake.

quotes.author: Aristophanes
quotes.quote: Wise people, even though all laws were abolished, would still lead the same life.

quotes.author: Aristophanes
quotes.quote: Under every stone lurks a politician.

quotes.author: Aristophanes
quotes.quote: Let each man exercise the art he knows.

quotes.author: Aristotle
quotes.quote: The ultimate value of life depends upon awareness and the power of contemplation rather than upon mere survival.

quotes.author: Aristotle
quotes.quote: The virtue of justice consists in moderation, as regulated by wisdom.

quotes.author: Aristotle
quotes.quote: The whole is more than the sum of its parts.

quotes.author: Aristotle
quotes.quote: The wise man does not expose himself needlessly to danger, since there are few things for which he cares sufficiently; but he is willing, in great crises, to give even his life - knowing that under certain conditions it is not worthwhile to live.

quotes.author: Aristotle
quotes.quote: The worst form of inequality is to try to make unequal things equal.

quotes.author: Aristotle
quotes.quote: The young are permanently in a state resembling intoxication.

quotes.author: Aristotle
quotes.quote: Therefore, the good of man must be the end of the science of politics.

quotes.author: Aristotle
quotes.quote: Those who excel in virtue have the best right of all to rebel, but then they are of all men the least inclined to do so.

quotes.author: Aristotle
quotes.quote: We must no more ask whether the soul and body are one than ask whether the wax and the figure impressed on it are one.

quotes.author: Aristotle
quotes.quote: What it lies in our power to do, it lies in our power not to do.

quotes.author: Aristotle
quotes.quote: What the statesman is most anxious to produce is a certain moral character in his fellow citizens, namely a disposition to virtue and the performance of virtuous actions.

quotes.author: Aristotle
quotes.quote: Wit is educated insolence.

quotes.author: Aristotle
quotes.quote: You will never do anything in this world without courage. It is the greatest quality of the mind next to honor.

quotes.author: Aristotle
quotes.quote: Youth is easily deceived because it is quick to hope.

quotes.author: Aristotle
quotes.quote: No great mind has ever existed without a touch of madness.

quotes.author: Aristotle
quotes.quote: Persuasion is achieved by the speaker's personal character when the speech is spoken as to make us think him credible. We believe good men more fully and more readily than others. This is true generally whatever the question is, and absolutely true where exact certainty is impossible and opinions are divided.

quotes.author: Aristotle
quotes.quote: The life of money-making is one undertaken under compulsion, and wealth is evidently not the good we are seeking; for it is merely useful and for the sake of something else.

quotes.author: Aristotle
quotes.quote: The more you know, the more you know you don't know.

quotes.author: Aristotle
quotes.quote: Our actions determine our dispositions.

quotes.author: Aristotle
quotes.quote: If you would understand anything, observe its beginning and its development.

quotes.author: Aristotle
quotes.quote: Moral virtues we acquire through practice like the arts.

quotes.author: Aristotle
quotes.quote: Art completes what nature cannot bring to finish. The artist gives us knowledge of nature's unrealized ends.

quotes.author: Arthur C. Clarke
quotes.quote: The only way of finding the limits of the possible is by going beyond them into the impossible.

quotes.author: Arthur C. Clarke
quotes.quote: Sometimes I think we're alone in the universe, and sometimes I think we're not. In either case, the idea is quite staggering.

quotes.author: Arthur C. Clarke
quotes.quote: I don't pretend we have the answers. But the questions are certainly worth thinking about.

quotes.author: Augustine Of Hippo
quotes.quote: Men go abroad to wonder at the height of mountains, at the huge waves of the sea, at the long courses of the rivers, at the vast compass of the ocean, at the circular motion of the stars; and they pass by themselves with out wondering.

quotes.author: Augustine Of Hippo
quotes.quote: Seek not to understand that you may believe, but believe that you may understand.

quotes.author: Augustine Of Hippo
quotes.quote: A free curiosity has more efficiency in learning than a frightful enforcement.

quotes.author: Augustine Of Hippo
quotes.quote: Habit, if not resisted, soon becomes necessity.

quotes.author: Augustine Of Hippo
quotes.quote: Pride changes angels into devils, humility makes man into angels.

quotes.author: Augustine Of Hippo
quotes.quote: Neither your wisdom be with pride, nor your humility without wisdom.

quotes.author: Augustine Of Hippo
quotes.quote: Necessity knows no law.

quotes.author: Augustine Of Hippo
quotes.quote: God had one son on earth without sin, but never one without suffering.

quotes.author: Augustine Of Hippo
quotes.quote: Prudence is the knowledge of what is to be sought and what is to be avoided.

quotes.author: Augustine Of Hippo
quotes.quote: The verdict of the world is conclusive.

quotes.author: Augustine of Hippo
quotes.quote: Bad company is like a nail driven into a post, which, after the first and second blow, may be drawn out with little difficulty; but being once driven up to the head, the pincers cannot take hold to draw it out, but which can only be done by the destruction of the wood.

quotes.author: Augustine of Hippo
quotes.quote: Do you wish to be great? Then begin by being. Do you desire to construct a vast and lofty fabric? Think first about the foundations of humility. The higher your structure is to be, the deeper must be its foundation.

quotes.author: Augustine of Hippo
quotes.quote: Do you wish to rise? Begin by descending. You plan a tower that will pierce the clouds? Lay first the foundation of humility.

quotes.author: Augustine of Hippo
quotes.quote: Faith is to believe what you do not see; the reward of this faith is to see what you believe.

quotes.author: Augustine of Hippo
quotes.quote: Give me chastity and continence, but not yet.

quotes.author: Augustine of Hippo
quotes.quote: Humility is the foundation of all the other virtues hence, in the soul in which this virtue does not exist there cannot be any other virtue except in mere appearance.

quotes.author: Augustine of Hippo
quotes.quote: If two friends ask you to judge a dispute, don't accept, because you will lose one friend; on the other hand, if two strangers come with the same request, accept because you will gain one friend.

quotes.author: Augustine of Hippo
quotes.quote: Pray as though everything depended on God. Work as though everything depended on you.

quotes.author: Augustine of Hippo
quotes.quote: Resentment is like drinking poison and waiting for the other person to die.

quotes.author: Augustine of Hippo
quotes.quote: Since you cannot do good to all, you are to pay special attention to those who, by the accidents of time, or place, or circumstances, are brought into closer connection with you.

quotes.author: Augustine of Hippo
quotes.quote: This is the very perfection of a man, to find out his own imperfections.

quotes.author: Augustine of Hippo
quotes.quote: What does love look like? It has the hands to help others. It has the feet to hasten to the poor and needy. It has eyes to see misery and want. It has the ears to hear the sighs and sorrows of men. That is what love looks like.

quotes.author: Augustine of Hippo
quotes.quote: Love is the beauty of the soul.

quotes.author: Augustine of Hippo
quotes.quote: The world is a book and those who do not travel read only one page.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: A word too much always defeats its purpose.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: It is with trifles, and when he is off guard, that a man best reveals his character.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: Ignorance is degrading only when found in company with riches.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: To desire immortality is to desire the eternal perpetuation of great mistake.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: Intellect is invisible to the man who has none.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: With people of only moderate ability, modesty is mere honesty; but with those who possess great talent, it is hypocrisy.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: Ordinary people think merely how they will spend their time, a man of intellect tries to use it.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: We forfeit three-fourths of ourselves in order to be like other people.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: Happiness belongs to those who are sufficient unto themselves. For all external sources of happiness and pleasure are, by their very nature, highly uncertain, precarious, ephemeral, and subject to chance.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: A man can be himself only so long as he is alone, and if he does not love solitude, he will not love freedom, for it is only when he is alone that he is really free.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: All truth passes through three stages. First, it is ridiculed. Second, it is violently opposed. Third, it is accepted as being self-evident.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: Almost all of our sorrows spring out of our relations with other people.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: Change alone is eternal, perpetual, immortal.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: Each day is a little life: every waking and rising a little birth, every fresh morning a little youth, every going to rest and sleep a little death.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: Friends and acquaintances are the surest passport to fortune.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: Great men are like eagles, and build their nest on some lofty solitude.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: Great minds are related to the brief span of time during which they live as great buildings are to a little square in which they stand: you cannot see them in all their magnitude because you are standing too close to them.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: I've never known any trouble than an hour's reading didn't assuage.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: Just remember, once you're over the hill you begin to pick up speed.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: Nature shows that with the growth of intelligence comes increased capacity for pain, and it is only with the highest degree of intelligence that suffering reaches its supreme point.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: Opinion is like a pendulum and obeys the same law. If it goes past the centre of gravity on one side, it must go a like distance on the other; and it is only after a certain time that it finds the true point at which it can remain at rest.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: Politeness is to human nature what warmth is to wax.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: Rascals are always sociable, more's the pity! and the chief sign that a man has any nobility in his character is the little pleasure he takes in others' company.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: Religion is the masterpiece of the art of animal training, for it trains people as to how they shall think.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: The alchemists in their search for gold discovered many other things of greater value.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: The discovery of truth is prevented more effectively, not by the false appearance things present and which mislead into error, not directly by weakness of the reasoning powers, but by preconceived opinion, by prejudice.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: The doctor sees all the weakness of mankind; the lawyer all the wickedness, the theologian all the stupidity.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: The first forty years of life give us the text; the next thirty supply the commentary on it.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: The greatest achievements of the human mind are generally received with distrust.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: The two enemies of human happiness are pain and boredom.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: Treat a work of art like a prince. Let it speak to you first.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: Will minus intellect constitutes vulgarity.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: Will power is to the mind like a strong blind man who carries on his shoulders a lame man who can see.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: After your death you will be what you were before your birth.

quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer
quotes.quote: Wealth is like seawater; the more we have, the thirstier we become, and the same is true of fame.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: But for all their inadequacy and their radical unlikeness to the facts to which they refer, words remain the most reliable and accurate of our symbols. Whenever we want to have a precise report of facts or ideas, we must resort to words.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: After silence, that which comes nearest to expressing the inexpressible is music.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: The advertisement is one of the most interesting and difficult of modern literary forms.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: And among that billion minus one; Might have chanced to be Shakespeare, another Newton, a new Doone – But the One was Me.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: The secret of genius is to carry the spirit of the child into old age, which means never losing your enthusiasm.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: There is no such thing as natural rights, there are only adjustments of conflicting claims.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: Experience is not what happens to you; it is what you do with what happens to you.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: Actual happiness always looks pretty squalid in comparison with the overcompensations for misery. And, of course, stability isn't nearly so spectacular as instability. And being contented has none of the glamour of a good fight against misfortune, none of the picturesqueness of a struggle with temptation, or a fatal overthrow by passion or doubt. Happiness is never grand.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: All that happens means something; nothing you do is ever insignificant.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: A love of nature keeps no factories busy.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: A really efficient totalitarian state would be one in which the all-powerful executive of political bosses and their army of managers control a population of slaves who do not have to be coerced, because they love their servitude.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: Armaments, universal debt, and planned obsolescence—those are the three pillars of Western prosperity. If war, waste, and moneylenders were abolished, you'd collapse. And while you people are overconsuming the rest of the world sinks more and more deeply into chronic disaster.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: Every man with a little leisure and enough money for railway tickets, every man, indeed, who knows how to read, has it in his power to magnify himself, to multiply the ways in which he exists, to make his life full, significant and interesting.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: Experience teaches only the teachable.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: Facts do not cease to exist because they are ignored.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: For in spite of language, in spite of intelligence and intuition and sympathy, one can never really communicate anything to anybody.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: Happiness is not achieved by the conscious pursuit of happiness; it is generally the by-product of other activities.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: If one's different, one's bound to be lonely.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: In spite of language, in spite of intelligence and intuition and sympathy, one can never really communicate anything to anybody. The essential substance of every thought and feeling remains incommunicable, locked up in the impenetrable strong-room of the individual soul and body. Our life is a sentence of perpetual solitary confinement.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: Ironically enough, the only people who can hold up indefinitely under the stress of modern war are psychotics. Individual insanity is immune to the consequences of collective insanity.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: It is a bit embarrassing to have been concerned with the human problem all one's life and find at the end that one has no more to offer by way of advice than 'Try to be a little kinder.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: I wanted to change the world. But I have found that the only thing one can be sure of changing is oneself.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: Man is so intelligent that he feels impelled to invent theories to account for what happens in the world. Unfortunately, he is not quite intelligent enough, in most cases, to find correct explanations. So that when he acts on his theories, he behaves very often like a lunatic.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: Most human beings have an almost infinite capacity for taking things for granted.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: ...most men and women will grow up to love their servitude and will never dream of revolution.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: One believes things because one has been conditioned to believe them.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: ...reality, however utopian, is something from which people feel the need of taking pretty frequent holidays....

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: Technological progress has merely provided us with more efficient means for going backwards.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: That men do not learn very much from the lessons of history is the most important of all the lessons that history has to teach.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: The more powerful and original a mind, the more it will incline towards the religion of solitude.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: The propagandist's purpose is to make one set of people forget that certain other sets of people are human.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: The real hopeless victims of mental illness are to be found among those who appear to be most normal. 'Many of them are normal because they are so well adjusted to our mode of existence, because their human voice has been silenced so early in their lives, that they do not even struggle or suffer or develop symptoms as the neurotic does.' They are normal not in what may be called the absolute sense of the word; they are normal only in relation to a profoundly abnormal society. Their perfect adjustment to that abnormal society is a measure of their mental sickness. These millions of abnormally normal people, living without fuss in a society to which, if they were fully human beings, they ought not to be adjusted.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: There are things known and there are things unknown, and in between are the doors of perception.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: To his dog, every man is Napoleon; hence the constant popularity of dogs.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: To travel is to discover that everyone is wrong about other countries.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: We live together, we act on, and react to, one another; but always and in all circumstances we are by ourselves. The martyrs go hand in hand into the arena; they are crucified alone. Embraced, the lovers desperately try to fuse their insulated ecstasies into a single self-transcendence; in vain. By its very nature every embodied spirit is doomed to suffer and enjoy in solitude. Sensations, feelings, insights, fancies—all these are private and, except through symbols and at second hand, incommunicable. We can pool information about experiences, but never the experiences themselves. From family to nation, every human group is a society of island universes.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: Words can be like X-rays if you use them properly — they’ll go through anything. You read and you’re pierced.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: Those who believe that they are exclusively in the right are generally those who achieve something.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: Official dignity tends to increase in inverse ratio to the importance of the country in which the office is held.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: There's only one corner of the universe you can be certain of improving, and that's your own self.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: Death ... It's the only thing we haven't succeeded in completely vulgarising.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: There are few who would not rather be taken in adultery than in provincialism.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: Chastity — the most unnatural of all the sexual perversions.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: The end cannot justify the means, for the simple and obvious reason that the means employed determine the nature of the ends produced.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: Too much consistency is as bad for the mind as it is for the body. Consistency is contrary to nature, contrary to life. The only completely consistent people are the dead.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: The greatest triumphs of propaganda have been accomplished, not by doing something, but by refraining from doing. Great is the truth, but still greater ... is silence about truth.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: Several excuses are always less convincing than one.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: Every significant artist is a metaphysician, a propounder of beauty-truths and form-theories.

quotes.author: Aldous Huxley
quotes.quote: Art is one of the means whereby man seeks to redeem a life which is experienced as chaotic, senseless, and largely evil.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: One should guard against preaching to young people success in the customary form as the main aim in life. The most important motive for work in school and in life is pleasure in work, pleasure in its result, and the knowledge of the value of the result to the community.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The only thing that interferes with my learning is my education.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: I know not with what weapons World War III will be fought, but World War IV will be fought with sticks and stones.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Politics is a pendulum whose swings between anarchy and tyranny are fuelled by perennially rejuvenated illusions.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Bear in mind that the wonderful things you learn in your schools are the work of many generations. All this is put in your hands as your inheritance in order that you may receive it, honor it, add to it, and one day faithfully hand it on to your children.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Don't listen to the person who has the answers; listen to the person who has the questions.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Two things are infinite: the universe and human stupidity; and I'm not sure about the universe.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The best design is the simplest one that works.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: To raise new questions, new possibilities, to regard old problems from a new angle, requires creative imagination and marks real advance in science.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: A man must learn to understand the motives of human beings, their illusions, and their sufferings.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The road to perdition has ever been accompanied by lip service to an ideal.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: In a sailboat I become oblivious to everything else in the world.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Our task must be to free ourselves by widening our circle of compassion to embrace all living creatures and the whole of nature and its beauty.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Don't dream of being a good person, be a human being is valuable and gives value to life.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Paper is to write things down that we need to remember. Our brains are used to think.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Knowledge exists in two forms-lifeless, stored in books, and alive, in the consciousness of men. The second form of existence is after all the essential one; the first, indispensable as it may be, occupies only an inferior position.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: I do not believe in immortality of the individual, and I consider ethics to be an exclusively human concern with no superhuman authority behind it.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Do you really believe that the moon isn't there when nobody looks?

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Feeling and longing are the motive forces behind all human endeavour and human creations.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Growth comes through analogy; through seeing how things connect, rather than only seeing how they might be different.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The Universe is stranger than we imagine!

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Formal symbolic representation of qualitative entities is doomed to its rightful place of minor significance in a world where flowers and beautiful women abound.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The mind that opens to a new idea never returns to its original size.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: We dance for laughter, we dance for tears, we dance for madness, we dance for fears, we dance for hopes, we dance for screams, we are the dancers, we create the dreams.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: I must be willing to give up what I am in order to become what I will be.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Nothing is more destructive of respect for the government and the law of the land than passing laws which cannot be enforced.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: If I were to remain silent, I'd be guilty of complicity.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: You have to color outside the lines once in a while if you want to make your life a masterpiece.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: It is the duty of every citizen according to his best capacities to give validity to his convictions in political affairs.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Heroism on command, senseless violence, and all the loathsome nonsense that goes by the name of patriotism - how passionately I hate them!

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Earth is the insane asylum of the universe.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: We are part of the whole which we call the universe, but it is an optical delusion of our mind that we think we are separate. This separateness is like a prison for us. Our job is to widen the circle of our compassion so we feel connected with all people and situations.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Only those who attempt the absurd can achieve the impossible.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Work is the only thing that gives substance to life.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Concepts that have proven useful in ordering things easily achieve such authority over us that we forget their earthly origins and accept them as unalterable givens.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: It is important to foster individuality, for only the individual can produce the new ideas.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: It is better to believe than to disbelieve; in doing you bring everything to the realm of possibility.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: My pacifism is not based on any intellectual theory but on a deep antipathy to every form of cruelty and hatred.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The health of society thus depends quite as much on the independence of the individuals composing it as on their close political cohesion.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: It would be better if you begin to teach others only after you yourself have learned something.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Our separation from each other is an optical illusion.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: To dwell on the things that depress or anger us does not help in overcoming them. One must knock them down alone.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Science is a sharp eye when it comes to the tools and approaches and be blind when it comes to values and goals.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The only thing more dangerous than ignorance is arrogance.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Reading, after a certain age, diverts the mind too much from its creative pursuits. Any man who reads too much and uses his own brain too little falls into lazy habits of thinking.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Whoever undertakes to set himself up as judge in the field of truth and knowledge is shipwrecked by the laughter of the Gods.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Scientists investigate that which already is; Engineers create that which has never been.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: He to whom this emotion is a stranger, who can no longer pause to wonder and stand rapt in awe, is as good as dead: his eyes are closed.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Human beings must have action; and they will make it if they cannot find it.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The important thing is not to stop questioning. Curiosity has its own reason for existing.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Excellence is doing a common thing in an uncommon way.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The environment is everything that isn't me.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Only morality in our actions can give beauty and dignity to life.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The mathematician knows some things, no doubt, but not those things one usually wants to get from him.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: What is important in understanding science is not technology.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: My religion consists of a humble admiration of the illimitable superior spirit who reveals himself in the slight details we are able to perceive with our frail and feeble mind.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: I believe that Gandhi's views were the most enlightened of all the political men in our time. We should strive to do things in his spirit: not to use violence in fighting for our cause, but by non-participation in anything you believe is evil.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Be a loner. That gives you time to wonder, to search for the truth. Have holy curiosity.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Somebody who only reads newspapers and at best books of contemporary authors looks to me like an extremely near-sighted person who scorns eyeglasses. He is completely dependent on the prejudices and fashions of his times, since he never gets to see or hear anything else.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: I believe, indeed, that overemphasis on the purely intellectual attitude, often directed solely to the practical and factual, in our education, has led directly to the impairment of ethical values.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: No one does anything right in life, until he realize that he is making a mistake.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The supreme goal of all theory is to make the irreducible basic elements as simple and as few as possible without having to surrender the adequate representation of a simple datum of experience.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: I never commit to memory anything that can easily be looked up in a book.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: When forced to summarize the general theory of relativity in one sentence: Time and space and gravitation have no separate existence from matter.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The release of atomic energy has not created a new problem. It has merely made more urgent the necessity of solving an existing one.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Organized people are just too lazy to go looking for what they want.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: For rebelling against every form of authority fate has punished me by making me an authority.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: One should never impose one's views on a problem; one should rather study it, and in time a solution will reveal itself.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Common sense is nothing more than a deposit of prejudices laid down in the mind before you reach eighteen.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Scientific research can reduce superstition by encouraging people to think and view things in terms of cause and effect.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Nothing will end war unless the people refuse to go to war.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: I see a pattern, but my imagination cannot picture the maker of that pattern. I see a clock, but I cannot envision the clockmaker. The human mind is unable to conceive of the four dimensions, so how can it conceive of a God, before whom a thousand years and a thousand dimensions are as one?

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Thinking is hard work; that's why so few do it.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: In any conflict between humanity and technology, humanity will win.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: If you want your children to be intelligent, read them fairy tales. If you want them to be more intelligent, read them more fairy tales.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Art is the expression of the profoundest thoughts in the simplest way.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: True religion is real living; living with all one's soul, with all one's goodness and righteousness.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: In scientific thinking are always present elements of poetry. Science and music requires a thought homogeneous.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: If God has created the world, his primary worry was certainly not to make its understanding easy for us.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The only escape from the miseries of life are music and cats.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: It is enough for me to contemplate the mystery of conscious life perpetuating itself through all eternity, to reflect upon the marvellous structure of the universe which we dimly perceive, and to try humbly to comprehend an infinitesimal part of the intelligence manifested in nature.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: That deep emotional conviction of the presence of a superior reasoning power, which is revealed in the incomprehensible universe, forms my idea of God.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: You cannot love a car the way you love a horse. The horse brings out human feelings the way machines cannot do. Things like machines may develop or neglect certain things in people ... Machines make our life impersonal and stultify certain elements in us and create an impersonal environment.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Don't wait for miracles, your whole life is a miracle.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: As a human being, one has been endowed with just enough intelligence to be able to see clearly how utterly inadequate that intelligence is when confronted with what exists.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: It should be possible to explain the laws of physics to a barmaid.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Intellectual growth should commence at birth and cease only at death.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: A society's competitive advantage will come not from how well its schools teach the multiplication and periodic tables, but from how well they stimulate imagination and creativity.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: I assert that the cosmic religious experience is the strongest and the noblest driving force behind scientific research.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: You can't blame gravity for falling in love.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: If a man aspires towards a righteous life, his first act of abstinence is from injury to animals.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The more I learn, the more I realize I don't know.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Stupidity is a personal achievement which transcends national boundaries.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Failing isn't bad when you learn what not to do.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: All these primary impulses, not easily described in words, are the springs of man's actions.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The greater the doubt, the greater the awakening.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: I admit that thoughts influence the body.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Learning is experience. Everything else is just information.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Any man who can drive safely while kissing a pretty girl is simply not giving the kiss the attention it deserves.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The words of language, as they are written or spoken, do not seem to play any role in my mechanism of thought. The physical entities which seem to serve as elements in thought are certain signs and more or less clear images.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Blind belief in authority is the greatest enemy of truth.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Anger dwells only in the bosom of fools.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: He who joyfully marches to music in rank and file has already earned my contempt. He has been given a large brain by mistake, since for him the spinal cord would suffice.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Computers are incredibly fast, accurate, and stupid: humans are incredibly slow, inaccurate and brilliant; together they are powerful beyond imagination.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Numerous are the academic professors, but rare are wise and noble teachers.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: If you want to live a happy life, tie it to a goal, not to people or things.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Human beings can attain a worthy and harmonious life only if they are able to rid themselves, within the limits of human nature, of the striving for the wish fulfilment of material kinds. The goal is to raise the spiritual values of society.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: One cannot alter a condition with the same mind set that created it in the first place.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: I never made one of my discoveries through the process of rational thinking.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Before God we are all equally wise - and equally foolish.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Man owes his strength in the struggle for existence to the fact that he is a social animal.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: If I could do it all again, I'd be a plumber.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Outer changes always begin with an inner change of attitude.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Adversity introduces a man to himself.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: It is only to the individual that a soul is given.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: I have come to know the mutability of all human relationships and have learned to insulate myself against both heat and cold so that a temperature balance is fairly well assured.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Striving for social justice is the most valuable thing to do in life.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Remember today, for it is the beginning of always. Today marks the start of a brave new future filled with all your dreams can hold. Think truly to the future and make those dreams come true.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Science is a wonderful thing if one does not have to earn one's living at it.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Let every man judge according to his own standards, by what he has himself read, not by what others tell him.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The only sure way to avoid making mistakes is to have no new ideas.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The only thing that you absolutely have to know, is the location of the library.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The monotony and solitude of a quiet life stimulates the creative mind.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Since the mathematicians have invaded the theory of relativity I do not understand it myself any more.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: An empty stomach is not a good political adviser.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Problems cannot be solved by thinking within the framework in which the problems were created.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: I see in Nature a magnificent structure... that must fill a thinking person with a feeling of humility...

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Science without religion is lame; religion without science is blind.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The most aggravating thing about the younger generation is that I no longer belong to it.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: God did not create evil. Just as darkness is the absence of light, evil is the absence of God.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Thanks to my fortunate idea of introducing the relativity principle into physics, you (and others) now enormously overrate my scientific abilities, to the point where this makes me quite uncomfortable.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The search for truth is more precious than its possession.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Nothing that I can do will change the structure of the universe. But maybe, by raising my voice I can help the greatest of all causes-goodwill among men and peace on earth.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Strange is our situation here on Earth. Each of us comes for a short visit, not knowing why, yet sometimes seeming to divine a purpose. From the standpoint of daily life, however, there is one thing we do know: that man is here for the sake of other men - above all for those upon whose smiles and well-being our own happiness depends.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: When you trip over love, it is easy to get up. But when you fall in love, it is impossible to stand again.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Rejoice with your family in the beautiful land of life.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The wonder of nature does not become smaller because one cannot measure it by the standards of human moral and human aims.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Future medicine will be the medicine of frequencies.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: There is only one road to human greatness: through the school of hard knocks.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: We know from daily life that we exist for other people first of all, for whose smiles and well-being our own happiness depends.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Understanding of our fellow human beings...becomes fruitful only when it is sustained by sympathetic feelings in joy and sorrow.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Education is the progressive realization of our ignorance.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: If something is in me which can be called religious, then it is the unbounded admiration for the structure of the world so far as our science can reveal it.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: I never teach my pupils, I only attempt to provide the conditions in which they can learn.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: God is subtle but he is not malicious.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Playfulness is the essential feature of productive thought.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Everyone must become their own person, however frightful that may be.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Where the world ceases to be the scene of our personal hopes and wishes, where we face it as free beings admiring, asking and observing, there we enter the realm of Art and Science.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Small is the number of people who see with their eyes and think with their minds.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The most important human endeavour is the striving for morality in our actions. Our inner balance and even our very existence depend on it. Only morality in our actions can give beauty and dignity to life.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The man who regards his own life and that of his fellow-creatures as meaningless is not merely unfortunate but almost disqualified for life.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Even on the most solemn occasions I got away without wearing socks and hid that lack of civilization in high boots.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Student is not a container you have to fill but a torch you have to light up.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: If one tries to navigate unknown waters one runs the risk of shipwreck.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Body and soul are not two different things, but only two different ways of perceiving the same thing. Similarly, physics and psychology are only different attempts to link our experiences together by way of systematic thought.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Nothing truly valuable can be achieved except by the unselfish cooperation of many individuals.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Men marry women with the hope they will never change. Women marry men with the hope they will change. Invariably they are both disappointed.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: If honey bees become extinct, human society will follow in four years.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: All I want to do is learn to think like God. All the rest is just details.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: No problem can be solved from the same level of consciousness that created it.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Learn from yesterday, live for today, hope for tomorrow. The important thing is not to stop questioning.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The true value of a human being can be found in the degree to which he has attained liberation from the self.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: You have to learn the rules of the game. And then you have to play better than anyone else.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The thinking that got us to where we are is not the thinking that will get us to where we want to be.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Any society which does not insist upon respect for all life must necessarily decay.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: God reveals himself in the orderly harmony of what exists.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: A single bomb of this type, carried by boat and exploded in a port, might very well destroy the whole port, together with some of the surrounding territory.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Without deep reflection one knows from daily life that one exists for other people.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Please explain the problem to me slowly, as I do not understand things quickly.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The finest emotion of which we are capable is the mystic emotion.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Although I am a typical loner in my daily life, my awareness of belonging to the invisible community of those who strive for truth, beauty, and justice has prevented me from feelings of isolation.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Children don't heed the life experiences of their parents, and nations ignore history. Bad lessons always have to be learned anew.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: I have not eaten enough of the tree of knowledge, though in my profession I am obligated to feed on it regularly.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: To understand the world one must not be worrying about one's self.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Compound interest is the eighth wonder of the world. He who understands it, earns it ... he who doesn't ... pays it.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Out of clutter, find Simplicity. From discord, find Harmony. In the middle of difficulty lies Opportunity.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Any intelligent fool can make things bigger, more complex, and more violent. It takes a touch of genius -- and a lot of courage -- to move in the opposite direction.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: It is easier to denature plutonium than to denature the evil spirit of man.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: If I had only one hour to save the world, I would spend fifty-five minutes defining the problem, and only five minutes finding the solution.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The theory must not contradict empirical facts.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: All that is valuable in human society depends upon the opportunity for development accorded the individual.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Life is a preparation for the future; and the best preparation for the future is to live as if there were none.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: To my mind, to kill in war is not a whit better than to commit ordinary murder.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: There could be no fairer destiny for any physical theory than that it should point the way to a more comprehensive theory in which it lives on as a limiting case.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Scarcely anyone who comprehends this theory can escape its magic.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: A table, a chair, a bowl of fruit and a violin; what else does a man need to be happy?

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: I once thought that if I could ask God one question, I would ask how the universe began, because once I knew that, all the rest is simply equations. But as I got older I became less concerned with how the universe began. Rather, I would want to know why he started the universe. For once I knew that answer, then I would know the purpose of my own life.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Teaching should be such that what is offered is perceived as a valuable gift and not as a hard duty.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Everything has changed, except our way of thinking.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The formulation of the problem is often more essential than its solution, which may be merely a matter of mathematical or experimental skill.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Once you can accept the universe as matter expanding into nothing that is something, wearing stripes with plaid comes easy.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: I believe in mystery and, frankly, I sometimes face this mystery with great fear. In other words, I think that there are many things in the universe that we cannot perceive or penetrate, and that also we experience some of the most beautiful things in life only in a very primitive form. Only in relation to these mysteries do I consider myself to be a religious man....

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: There are times when one feels liberated from one's limits and human imperfections. At such moments, we see ourselves there, in a little corner of our little planet, our eyes fixed in wonder on the cold and yet deep beauty of that which is eternal, that which is elusive. Life and death are fused together and there is no evolution, nor destination, there is only BEING.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: I am absolutely convinced that no wealth in the world can help humanity forward, even in the hands of the most devoted worker in this cause. The example of great and pure characters is the only thing that can produce fine ideas and noble deeds. Money only appeals to selfishness and always tempts its owners irresistibly to abuse it.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: If people would only talk about what they understood, Earth would be a very quiet place.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: I very rarely think in words at all. A thought comes, and I may try to express it in words afterwards.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: For me a simple message, to think and act with courage, independence and imagination.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Genius abhors consensus because when consensus is reached, thinking stops. Stop nodding your head.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Concerning matter, we have been all wrong. What we have called matter is energy, whose vibration has been so lowered as to be perceptible to the senses. There is no matter.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The value of a man should be seen in what he gives and not in what he is able to receive.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Nationalism is an infantile disease. It is the measles of mankind.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: A tyranny based on ... deception and maintained by terror must inevitably perish from the poison it generates within itself.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Any fool can know. The point is to understand.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: One cannot help but be in awe when [one] contemplates the mysteries of eternity, of life, of the marvellous structure of reality.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: A knowledge of the existence of something we cannot penetrate, of the manifestations of the profoundest reason and the most radiant beauty - it is this knowledge and this emotion that constitute the truly religious attitude; in this sense, and in this alone, I am a deeply religious man.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The individual must not merely wait and criticize, he must defend the cause the best he can. The fate of the world will be such as the world deserves.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: I have reached an age where if someone tells me to wear socks, I don't have to.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: This crippling of individuals I consider the worst evil of capitalism. Our whole educational system suffers from this evil. An exaggerated competitive attitude is inculcated into the student, who is trained to worship acquisitive success as a preparation for his future.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Weakness of attitude becomes weakness of character.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: As far as the laws of mathematics refer to reality, they are not certain; and as far as they are certain, they do not refer to reality.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The devil has put a penalty on all things we enjoy in life. Either we suffer in health or we suffer in soul or we get fat.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: If one day you have to choose between the world and love, remember this: If you choose the world you'll be left without love, but if you choose love, with it you will conquer the world.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Never underestimate your own ignorance.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: I am thankful to all those who said no. It's because of them, I did it myself.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: At least once a day, allow yourself the freedom to think and dream for yourself.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Coincidence is God's way of remaining anonymous.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The scientist is activated by a wonder and awe before the mysterious comprehensibility of the universe which is yet finally beyond his grasp. In its profoundest depths it is inaccessible to man.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: A man's actions are determined by necessity, external and internal.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Black holes are where God divided by zero.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: We have to do the best we can. This is our sacred human responsibility.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Creativity is seeing what others see and thinking what no one else has ever thought.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The pursuit of truth and beauty is a sphere of activity in which we are permitted to remain children all our lives.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The grand aim of all science is to cover the greatest number of empirical facts by logical deduction from the smallest number of hypotheses or axioms.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: If men as individuals surrender to the call of their elementary instincts, avoiding pain and seeking satisfaction only for their own selves, the result for them all taken together must be a state of insecurity, of fear, and of promiscuous misery.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: I speak to everyone in the same way, whether he is the garbage man or the president of the university.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: We still do not know one thousandth of one percent of what nature has revealed to us.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: All that's different about me is that I still ask the questions most people stopped asking at age five.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Most of the fundamental ideas of science are essentially simple, and may, as a rule, be expressed in a language comprehensible to everyone.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: We are boxed in by the boundary conditions of our thinking.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: If the bee disappeared off the surface of the globe, then man would have only four years of life left. No more bees, no more pollination, no more plants, no more animals, no more man.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: I'm more interested in the future than in the past, because the future is where I intend to live.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The value of achievement lies in the achieving.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Most people say that it is the intellect which makes a great scientist. They are wrong: it is character.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The strength of the Constitution lies entirely in the determination of each citizen to defend it. Only if every single citizen feels duty bound to do his share in this defence are the constitutional rights secure.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The most important decision we make is whether we believe we live in a friendly or hostile universe.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: When men are engaged in war and conquest, the tools of science become as dangerous as a razor in the hands of a child of three. We must not condemn man because his inventiveness and patient conquest of the forces of nature are being exploited for false and destructive purposes. Rather, we should remember that the fate of mankind hinges entirely upon man's moral development.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: After a certain high level of technical skill is achieved science and art tend to coalesce in aesthetics, plasticity, and form. The greatest scientists are artists as well.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: It is the theory that decides what can be observed.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Never lose a holy curiosity. Try not to become a man of success but rather try to become a man of value. He is considered successful in our day who gets more out of life than he puts in. But a man of value will give more than he receives.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: If I can't picture it, I can't understand it.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: An expert is a person who has few new ideas; a beginner is a person with many.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: It is my inner conviction that the development of science seeks in the main to satisfy the longing for pure knowledge.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Learning is the beginning of wealth. Searching and learning is where the miracle process all begins. The great breakthrough in your life comes when you realize it that you can learn anything you need to learn to accomplish any goal that you set for yourself. This means there are no limits on what you can be, have or do.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: As far as I'm concerned, I prefer silent vice to ostentatious virtue.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Energy cannot be created or destroyed, it can only be changed from one form to another.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Education is not received. It is achieved.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The most beautiful gift of nature is that it gives one pleasure to look around and try to comprehend what we see.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: I'd rather be an optimist and a fool than a pessimist and right.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: It occurred to me by intuition, and music was the driving force behind that intuition. My discovery was the result of musical perception.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: I like to experience the universe as one harmonious whole. Every cell has life. Matter, too, has life; it is energy solidified. The tree outside is life... The whole of nature is life... The basic laws of the universe are simple, but because our senses are limited, we can't grasp them. There is a pattern in creation.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: When a man is sufficiently motivated, discipline will take care of itself.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: A man's ethical behaviour should be based effectually on sympathy, education, and social ties and needs; no religious basis is necessary. Man would indeed be in a poor way if he had to be restrained by fear of punishment and hope of reward after death.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: To invent something, all you need is imagination and a big pile of junk.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: It is entirely possible that behind the perception of our senses, worlds are hidden of which we are unaware.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Do you believe in miracles? Well, you should. In fact, life itself is a big miracle. There are so many things that are beyond our understanding. There are two ways to live: you can live as if nothing is a miracle; you can live as if everything is a miracle.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: In a healthy nation there is a kind of dramatic balance between the will of the people and the government, which prevents its degeneration into tyranny.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The measure of intelligence is the ability to change.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Time and space are modes by which we think and not conditions in which we live.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The one who walks alone, is likely to find himself in places no one has ever been.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: A conviction akin to religious feeling of the rationality or intelligibility of the world lies behind all scientific work of a high order.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Physical concepts are free creations of the human mind, and are not, however it may seem, uniquely determined by the external world.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: In art, and in the higher ranges of science, there is a feeling of harmony which underlies all endeavour. There is no true greatness in art or science without that sense of harmony.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Whatever there is of God and goodness in the universe, it must work itself out and express itself through us. We cannot stand aside and let God do it.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: I live my daydreams in music I see my life in terms of music. I get most joy in life out of music.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The only source of knowledge is experience.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The ability to portray people in still life and in motion requires the highest measure of intuition and talent.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The only way to escape the personal corruption of praise is to go on working. One is tempted to stop and listen to it. The only thing is to turn away and go on working. Work. There is nothing else.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Truth is what stands the test of experience.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: A little knowledge is a dangerous thing. So is a lot.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Everything in life is vibration.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: A theory is something nobody believes, except the person who made it. An experiment is something everybody believes, except the person who made it.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: I think and think for months and years. Ninety-nine times, the conclusion is false. The hundredth time I am right.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Morality is of the highest importance - but for us, not for God.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Few are those who see with their own eyes and feel with their own hearts.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: There comes a time when the mind takes a higher plane of knowledge but can never prove how it got there.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Knowledge is limited; but imagination encircles the world.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: We are here for the sake of others.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: My sense of god is my sense of wonder about the universe.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: There could be no greater calamity than a permanent discord between us and the Arab people. Despite the great wrong that has been done us, we must strive for a just and lasting compromise with the Arab people Let us recall that in former times no people lived in greater friendship with us than the ancestors of these Arabs.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: You cannot simultaneously prevent and prepare for war.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Matter is spirit reduced to point of visibility.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Three great forces rule the world: stupidity, fear and greed.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: I believe in standardizing automobiles. I do not believe in standardizing human beings. Standardization is a great peril which threatens American culture.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Mozart's music is so pure and beautiful that I see it as a reflection of the inner beauty of the universe.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: I never thought that others would take my theories so much more seriously than I did.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: In theory, theory and practice are the same. In practice, they are not.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Concern for man and his fate must always form the chief interest of all technical endeavours. Never forget this in the midst of your diagrams and equations.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The most powerful force in the world is compound interest.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: We all know that light travels faster than sound. That's why certain people appear bright until you hear them speak.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The distinctions separating the social classes are false; in the last analysis they rest on force.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: It is humankind's duty to respect all life, not only animals have feelings but even also trees and plants.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: To get to know a country, you must have direct contact with the earth. It's futile to gaze at the world through a car window.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: I am also convinced that one gains the purest joy from spirited things only when they are not tied in with earning one's livelihood.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The religion of the future will be cosmic religion. It will transcend personal God and avoid dogma and theology.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: A person experiences life as something separated from the rest a kind of optical delusion of consciousness. Our task must be to free ourselves from this self-imposed prison, and through compassion, to find the reality of Oneness.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: A photograph never grows old. You and I change, people change all through the months and years but a photograph always remains the same. How nice to look at a photograph of mother or father taken many years ago. You see them as you remember them. But as people live on, they change completely. That is why I think a photograph can be kind.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The man with the greatest soul will always face the greatest war with the low minded person.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The more I study science, the more I believe in God.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: If the facts don't fit the theory, change the facts.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Solitude is painful when one is young, but delightful when one is more mature.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The tragedy of life is what dies in the hearts and souls of people while they live.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: It is every man's obligation to put back into the world at least the equivalent of what he takes out of it.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The most amazing thing about the world is that we understand it.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Enjoying the joys of others and suffering with them - these are the best guides for man.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: It almost seems to me that man was not born to be a carnivore.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Out yonder there is this huge world, which exists independently of us human beings and which stands before us like a great, eternal riddle, at least partially accessible to our inspection and thinking.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: To sense that behind anything that can be experienced there is a something that our mind cannot grasp and whose beauty and sublimity reaches us only indirectly and as a feeble reflection, this is religiousness. In this sense I am religious.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The process of scientific discovery is, in effect, a continual flight from wonder.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The difference between what the most and the least learned people know is inexpressibly trivial in relation to that which is unknown.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Great spirits have always encountered violent opposition from mediocre minds.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Scientists believe that every occurrence, including the affairs of human beings, is due to the laws of nature. Therefore a scientist cannot be inclined to believe that the course of events can be influenced by prayer, that is, by a supernaturally manifested wish.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Something deeply hidden had to be behind things.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: True art is characterized by an irresistible urge in the creative artist.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: I shall never believe that God plays dice with the world.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: One of the strongest motives that lead men to art and science is escape from everyday life with its painful crudity and hopeless dreariness, from the fetters of one's own ever-shifting desires. A finely tempered nature longs to escape from the personal life into the world of objective perception and thought.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: It is not a lack of real affection that scares me away again and again from marriage. Is it a fear of the comfortable life, of nice furniture, of dishonor that I burden myself with, or even the fear of becoming a contented bourgeois.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The most incomprehensible thing about the world is that it is comprehensible.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The world as we have created it is a process of our thinking. It cannot be changed without changing our thinking.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The true measure of a man is the degree to which he has managed to subjugate his ego.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
