quotes.quote: Laws alone can not secure freedom of expression; in order that every man present his views without penalty there must be spirit of tolerance in the entire population.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Each makes this cosmos and its construction the pivot of his emotional life, in order to find in this way peace and security which he can not find in the narrow whirlpool of personal experience.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: I became more and more convinced that even nature could be understood as a relatively simple mathematical structure.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Memory is deceptive because it is colored by today's events.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Knowledge of what is does not open the door directly to what should be.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Life is a mystery, not a problem waiting to be solved.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: I think that only daring speculation can lead us further and not accumulation of facts.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: I want to go when I want. It is tasteless to prolong life artificially. I have done my share, it is time to go. I will do it elegantly.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The unleashed power of the atom has changed everything save our modes of thinking and we thus drift toward unparalleled catastrophe.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Those who have the privilege to know have the duty to act.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: It is open to every man to choose the direction of his striving; and also every man may draw comfort from Lessing's fine saying, that the search for truth is more precious than its possession.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: A happy man is too satisfied with the present to dwell too much on the future.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The intuitive mind is a sacred gift and the rational mind is a faithful servant. We have created a society that honors the servant and has forgotten the gift.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: The truth of a theory is in your mind, not in your eyes.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: That a man can take pleasure in marching in formation to the strains of a band is enough to make me despise him. He has only been given his big brain by mistake; a backbone was all he needed.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.quote: Time is not at all what it seems. It does not flow in only one direction, and the future exists simultaneously with the past.

quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: Better it is to live one day seeing the rise and fall of things than to live a hundred years without ever seeing the rise and fall of things.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: When we meet real tragedy in life, we can react in two ways--either by losing hope and falling into self-destructive habits, or by using the challenge to find our inner strength.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: Neither fire nor wind, birth nor death can erase our good deeds.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: If anything is worth doing, do it with all your heart.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: All beings tremble before violence. All fear death, all love life. See yourself in others. Then whom can you hurt? What harm can you do?

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: Having gone on his almsround, the sage should then go to the forest, standing or taking a seat at the foot of a tree. The enlightened one, intent on jhana, should find delight in the forest, should practice jhana at the foot of a tree, attaining his own satisfaction.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: Delight in heedfulness! Guard well your thoughts!

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: Calm mind brings inner strength and self-confidence, so that's very important for good health.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: In whom there is no sympathy for living beings: know him as an outcast.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: To refrain from evil and from strong drink and to be always, steadfast in virtue; this is the good luck.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: Endurance is one of the most difficult disciplines, but it is to the one who endures that the final victory comes.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: Let all-embracing thoughts for all beings be yours.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: Peace does not mean an absence of conflicts; differences will always be there. Peace means solving these differences through peaceful means; through dialogue, education, knowledge; and through humane ways.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: Teach this triple truth to all: A generous heart, kind speech, and a life of service and compassion are the things which renew humanity.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: Anger or hatred is like a fisherman's hook. It is very important for us to ensure that we are not caught by it.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: Should you find a wise critic to point out your faults, follow him as you would a guide to hidden treasure.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: You must not hate those who do wrong or harmful things; but with compassion, you must do what you can to stop them - for they are harming themselves, as well as those who suffer from their actions.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: All suffering is caused by ignorance. People inflict pain on others in the selfish pursuit of their own happiness or satisfaction.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: When you practice gratefulness, there is a sense of respect toward others.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: He who can curb his wrath as soon as it arises, as a timely antidote will check snake's venom that so quickly spreads - such a monk gives up the here and the beyond, just as a serpent sheds its worn-out skin.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: Be a lamp unto yourself. Work out your liberation with diligence.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: Whatever precious jewel there is in the heavenly worlds, there is nothing comparable to one who is Awakened.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: If you can cultivate the right attitude, your enemies are your best spiritual teachers because their presence provides you with the opportunity to enhance and develop tolerance, patience and understanding.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: All wrong-doing arises because of mind. If mind is transformed can wrong-doing remain?

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: Resolutely train yourself to attain peace.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: A dog is not considered a good dog because he is a good barker. A man is not considered a good man because he is a good talker.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: Follow then the shining ones, the wise, the awakened, the loving, for they know how to work and forbear.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: For things to reveal themselves to us, we need to be ready to abandon our views about them.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: It is very important to generate a good attitude, a good heart, as much as possible. From this, happiness in both the short term and the long term for both yourself and others will come.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: Choose to be optimistic, it feels better.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: All things appear and disappear because of the concurrence of causes and conditions. Nothing ever exists entirely alone; everything is in relation to everything else.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: Life is available only in the present moment.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: As I am, so are these. As are these, so am I. Drawing the parallel to yourself, neither kill nor get others to kill.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: We can never obtain peace in the outer world until we make peace with ourselves.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: Virtue is persecuted more by the wicked than it is loved by the good.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: Anger is the ultimate destroyer of your own peace of mind.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: There has to be evil so that good can prove its purity above it.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: To live fully, we must learn to use things and love people, and not love things and use people.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: Everyone and everything around you is your teacher.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: Even if things don't unfold the way you expected, don't be disheartened or give up. One who continues to advance will win in the end.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: Letting go gives us freedom, and freedom is the only condition for happiness. If, in our heart, we still cling to anything - anger, anxiety, or possessions - we cannot be free.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: Look at situations from all angles, and you will become more open.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: We will develop and cultivate the liberation of mind by loving kindness, make it our vehicle, make it our basis, stabilize it, exercise ourselves in it, and fully perfect it.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: A person, who no matter how desperate the situation, gives others hope, is a true leader.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: He is not the same, nor is he another.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: My actions are my only true belongings.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: If you light a lamp for someone else it will also brighten your path.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: The charitable man is loved by all; his friendship is prized highly.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: Happy is he who has overcome all selfishness; happy is he who has attained peace, and happy is he who has found the truth.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: A fool, though he lives in the company of the wise, understands nothing of the true doctrine, as a spoon tastes not the flavor of the soup.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: Mind is the most subtle of all elements in the phenomenal universe. All objectified consciousness has its origin in the mind. One who speaks or acts with a pure mind, happiness abides with him as his own shadow.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: Perfect peace can dwell only where all vanity has disappeared.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: Goodwill towards all beings is the true religion; cherish in your hearts boundless goodwill to all that lives.

quotes.author: Buddha
quotes.quote: Drop by drop is the water pot filled. Likewise, the wise man, gathering it little by little, fills himself with good.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: 'What is' is more important than 'what should be.' Too many people are looking at 'what is' from a position of thinking 'what should be'.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: A good martial artist does not become tense, but ready. Not thinking, yet not dreaming. Ready for whatever may come. When the opponent expands, I contract; and when he contracts, I expand. And when there is an opportunity, "I" do not hit, "it" hits all by itself.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: A good teacher can never be fixed in a routine... each moment requires a sensitive mind that is constantly changing and constantly adapting. A teacher must never impose this student to fit his favourite pattern; a good teacher functions as a pointer, exposing his student's vulnerability (and) causing him to explore both internally and finally integrating himself with his being. Martial art should not be passed out indiscriminately.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: A quality martial artist is always ready for any move, and trains oneself invincible.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: A self-willed man obeys a different law, the one law I, too, hold absolutely sacred — the human law in himself, his own individual will.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Action is a high road to self-confidence and esteem. Where it is open, all energies flow toward it. It comes readily to most people, and its rewards are tangible.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: All types of knowledge, ultimately mean self knowledge.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: An instructor should exemplify the things he seeks to teach. It will be of great advantage if you yourself can do all you ask of your students and more.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: An intelligent mind is an inquiring mind. It is not satisfied with explanation, with conclusions. Nor is it a mind that believes, because belief is again another form of conclusion.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Anxiety is the gap between the NOW and the THEN. So if you are in the NOW, you can't be anxious, because your excitement flows immediately into ongoing spontaneous activity.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Any technique, however worthy and desirable, becomes a disease when the mind is obsessed with it.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Art calls for complete mastery of techniques, developed by reflection within the soul.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Art reaches its greatest peak when devoid of self-consciousness. Freedom discovers man the moment he loses concern over what impression he is making or about to make.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: As an instructor, you must be able to distinguish between poor performance caused by lack of ability or aptitude on the part of the student and poor performance caused by lack of effort. You should treat the first with patience and the latter with firmness. You must never apply sarcasm and ridicule.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: As long as we separate this oneness into two we won't achieve realization.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Balance your thoughts with action. If you spend too much time thinking about a thing, you'll never get it done.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Be aware of doing your best to understand the ROOT in life, and realize the DIRECT and the INDIRECT are in fact a complementary WHOLE. It is to see things as they are and not to become attached to anything — to be unconscious meant to be be innocent of the working of a relative (empirical) mind — where there is no abiding of though anywhere on anything — this is being unbound. This not abiding anywhere is the root of our life.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Believe me that in every big thing or achievement there are always obstacles-big or small- and the reaction one shows to such obstacles is what counts, not the obstacle itself.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Cease negative mental chattering. If you think a thing is impossible, you'll make it impossible. Pessimism blunts the tools you need to succeed.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Concentration is the ROOT of all the higher abilities in man.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Conditioning obstructs our view of reality. We do not see IT in its suchness because of our indoctrination, crooked and twisted.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Defeat is not defeat unless accepted as a reality-in your own mind.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Defense is attack, attack is defense, each being the cause and result of the other.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Do not allow negative thoughts to enter your mind for they are the weeds that strangle confidence.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Do not deny the classical approach, simply as a reaction, or you will have created another pattern and trapped yourself there.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Do not have an attitude, open yourself and focus yourself and express yourself. Reject external form that fails to express internal reality.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Don't be forecasting evil unless it is what you can guard against. Anxiety is good for nothing if we can't turn it into a defense.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Don't fear failure. Not failure, but low aim, is the crime. In great attempts it is glorious even to fail.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Don't get set into one form, adapt it and build your own, and let it grow, be like water. Empty your mind, be formless, shapeless — like water. Now you put water in a cup, it becomes the cup; You put water into a bottle it becomes the bottle; You put it in a teapot it becomes the teapot. Now water can flow or it can crash. Be water, my friend.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Don't think, feel.... it is like a finger pointing a way to the moon. Don't concentrate on the finger or you will miss all that heavenly glory!

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Emptiness the starting point. In order to taste my cup of water you must first empty your cup. My friend, drop all your preconceived and fixed ideas and be neutral. Do you know why this cup is useful? Because it is empty.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Even today, I dare not say that I have reached a state of achievement. I'm still learning, for learning is boundless.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Everybody has to think for himself. A right way for a big man may not be a right way for a small man. A right way for someone who is slow may not be a right way for someone who is quick. Each person must understand his weaknesses and his strengths.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Faith makes it possible to achieve that which man's mind can conceive and believe.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Flow in the living moment - We are always in a process of becoming and nothing is fixed.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: For it is easy to criticize and break down the spirit of others, but to know yourself takes a lifetime.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Forget about winning and losing; forget about pride and pain. Let your opponent graze your skin and you smash into his flesh; let him smash into your flesh and you fracture his bones; let him fracture your bones and you take his life. Do not be concerned with escaping safely — lay your life before him.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Genius: The capacity to see and to express what is simple, simply!

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Give up thinking as though not giving it up. Observe techniques as though not observing.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Have no rigid system in you, and you'll be flexible to change with the ever changing.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: He who wants to succeed should learn how to fight, to strive and to suffer. You can acquire a lot in life, if you are prepared to give up a lot to get it.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Here I am as a human being...how can I express myself, totally and completely?

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Humility forms the basis of honor, just as the low ground forms the foundation of a high elevation.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: I don't know what is the meaning of death, but I am not afraid to die - and I go on, non-stop, going forward [with life]. Even though I, Bruce Lee, may die some day without fulfilling all of my ambitions, I will have no regrets. I did what I wanted to do and what I've done, I've done with sincerity and to the best of my ability. You can't expect much more from life.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: I have always been a martial artist by choice, an actor by profession, but above all, am actualising myself to be an artist of life.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: I have the absolute confidence not to be number two, but then I have enough sense to realize that there can be no number one.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: I personally do not believe in the word style. Why? Because, unless there are human beings with three arms and four legs, unless we have another group of human beings that are structurally different from us, there can be no different style of fighting.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: If every man would help his neighbor, no man would be without help.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: If I tell you I'm good, probably you will say I'm boasting. But if I tell you I'm not good, you'll know I'm lying.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: If nothing within you stays rigid, outward things will disclose themselves. Moving, be like water. Still, be like a mirror. Respond like an echo.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: If one loves, one need not have an ideology of love.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: If there is always light, you don't experience light anymore. You have to have the rhythm of light and darkness.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: If thought exists, I who think and the world about which I think also exist; the one exists but for the other, having no possible separation between them. Therefore, the world and I are both in active correlation; I am that which sees the world, and the world is that which is seen by me. I exist for the world and the world exists for me. ... One sure and primary and fundamental fact is the joint existence of a subject and of its world. The one does not exist without the other. I acquire no understanding of myself except as I take account of objects, of the surroundings. I do not think unless I think of things — and there I find myself.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: If you don't want to slip up tomorrow, speak the truth today.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: If you want to do your duty properly, you should do just a little more than that.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: If your opponent is at a distance, kick him in the groin. If he gets close, poke him in the eyes, bring up your knee, pop him with an elbow, dig a corkscrew punch to his stomach.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: In Buddhism, there is no place for using effort. Just be ordinary and nothing special. Eat your food, move your bowels, pass water and when you're tired go and lie down. The ignorant will laugh at me, but the wise will understand.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: In life, what more can you ask for than to be real? To fulfill one's potential instead of wasting energy on [attempting to] actualize one's dissipating image, which is not real and an expenditure of one's vital energy. We have great work ahead of us, and it needs devotion and much, much energy. To grow, to discover, we need involvement, which is something I experience every day — sometimes good, sometimes frustrating. No matter what, you must let your inner light guide you out of the darkness.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: In order to control myself I must first accept myself by going with and not against my nature.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: In order to realize our true self we must be willing to live without being dependent upon the opinion of others.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: In Science we have finally come back to the pre-Socratic philosopher Heraclitus, who said everything is flow, flux, process. There are no "things." NOTHINGNESS in Eastern language is "no-thingness". We in the West think of nothingness as a void, an emptiness, an nonexistence. In Eastern philosophy and modern physical science, nothingness — no-thingness — is a form of process, ever moving.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: It is easy for me to put on a show and be cocky... but to express oneself honestly not lying to oneself, now that my friend is very hard to do.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: It is not a shame to be knocked down by other people. The important thing is to ask when you're being knocked down, 'Why am I being knocked down?' If a person can reflect in this way, then there is hope for this person.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: It is useless to try to stir the dirt Out of the muddy water, As it will become murkier. But leave it alone, And if it should be cleared; It will become clear by itself.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Know the difference between a catastrophe and an inconvenience. To realize that it's just an inconvenience, that it is not a catastrophe, but just an unpleasantness, is part of coming into your own, part of waking up.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Knowledge will give you power, but character respect.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Knowledge, surely, is always of time, whereas knowing is not of time. Knowledge is from a source, from accumulation, from conclusion, while knowing is a movement.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Learning is never cumulative, it is a movement of knowing which has no beginning and no end.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Let the spirit out - Discard all thoughts of reward, all hopes of praise and fears of blame, all awareness of one's bodily self. And, finally closing the avenues of sense perception, let the spirit out, as it will.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Liberate yourself from concepts and see the truth with your own eyes. It exists HERE and NOW; it requires only one thing to see it: openness, freedom — the freedom to be open and not tethered by any ideas, concepts, etc. ... When our mind is tranquil, there will be an occasional pause to its feverish activities, there will be a let-go, and it is only then in the interval between two thoughts that a flash of UNDERSTANDING — understanding, which is not thought — can take place.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Life is an ever-flowing process and somewhere on the path some unpleasant things will pop up - it might leave a scar, but then life is flowing, and like running water, when it stops it grows stale. Go bravely on, my friend, because each experience teaches us a lesson. Keep blasting because life is such that sometimes it is nice and sometimes it is not.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Life is better lived than conceptualized. This writing can be less demanding should I allow myself to indulge in the usual manipulating game of role creation. Fortunately for me, my self-knowledge has transcended that and I've come to understand that life is best to be lived — not to be conceptualized. If you have to think, you still do not understand.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Life is never stagnation. It is constant movement, unrhythmic movement, as we as constant change. Things live by moving and gain strength as they go.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Life is wide, limitless. There is no border, no frontier.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Life itself is your teacher, and you are in a state of constant learning.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Life lives; and in the living flow, no questions are raised. The reason is that life is a living now! So, in order to live life whole-heartedly, the answer is life simply is.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Like everyone else, you want to learn the way to win, but never to accept the way to lose - to accept defeat. To learn to die is to be liberated from it. So when tomorrow comes you must free your ambitious mind and learn the art of dying!

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Loneliness is only an opportunity to cut adrift and find yourself. In solitude you are least alone.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Love is like a friendship caught on fire. In the beginning a flame, very pretty, often hot and fierce, but still only light and flickering. As love grows older, our hearts mature and our love becomes as coals, deep-burning and unquenchable.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Make at least one definite move daily toward your goal.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Man, the living creature, the creating individual, is always more important than any established style or system.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Many people dedicate their lives to actualizing a concept of what they should be like, rather than actualizing themselves. This difference between self-actualization and self-image actualization is very important. Most people live only for their image.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Maturation is the development from environmental support to self-support.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Meaning is found in relationship. Meaning is the relationship of the foreground figure to the background.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: More and more I believe in the fact that you have two hands and two legs, and the thing is how to make good use of yourself - and that's about it.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Never waste energy on worries or negative thoughts, all problems are brought into existence -drop them.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Now I see that I will never find the light Unless, like the candle, I am my own fuel, Consuming myself.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Nowadays you don't go around on the street kicking people, punching people — because if you do (makes gun shape with hand), well that's it — I don't care how good you are.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: One must be truthful and honest in his approach; a constant independent inquiry and not blindly following a certain blue print laid down by others.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: One should be in harmony with, not in opposition to, the strength and force of the opposition. This means that one should do nothing that is not natural or spontaneous; the important thing is not to strain in any way.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: One will never get any more than he thinks he can get. YOU HAVE WHAT IT TAKES. Look back and see your progress - damn the torpedo, full speed ahead!

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Only the self-sufficient stand alone - most people follow the crowd and imitate.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: People try to hold onto the sameness. This holding onto prevents growth.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Persistence, persistence, and persistence. The Power can be created and maintained through daily practice - continuous effort.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Practice makes perfect. After a long time of practicing, our work will become natural, skillful, swift, and steady.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Prosperity is apt to prevent us from examining our conduct; but adversity leads us to think properly of our state, and so is beneficial to us.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Put 'going the extra mile' to work as part of one's daily habit.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Reality is apparent when one ceases to compare. There is "what is" only when there is no comparison at all, and to live with what is, is to be peaceful.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Reality is being itself. It is being itself, in becoming itself. Reality in its isness, the "isness" of a thing. Thus isness is the meaning — having freedom in its primary sense — not limited by attachments, confinements, partialization, complexities.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Recognizing that the power of will is the supreme court over all other departments of my mind, I will exercise daily when I need the urge to act for any purpose; and I will form habits designed to bring the power of my will into action at least once daily.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Relationship is the mirror in which you discover yourself - to be is to be related.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Remember my friend to enjoy your planning as well as your accomplishment, for life is too short for negative energy.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Running water never grows stale. So you just have to 'keep on flowing.'

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Satori - in the awakening from a dream. Awakening and self-realization and seeing into one's own being - these are synonymous.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Seek to understand the root. It is futile to argue as to which single leaf, which design of branch, or which attractive flower you like; when you understand the root, you understand all its blossoming.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Since life is an ever evolving process, one should flow in this process and discover how to actualize and expand oneself.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Since weight training involves repetitions, a great deal of energy must be exerted. Therefore, weight training should be practiced only every other day.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Sincere thought means thought of concentration (quiet awareness). The thought of a distracted mind cannot be sincere.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Sorrows are our best educator. A man can see further through a tear than a telescope.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Stop wasting time in playing a role or a concept. Instead, learn to ACTUALIZE YOURSELF, your potential.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: Take inventory of everyone with whom you have contact.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: The abdominal and waist region coordinate all parts of the body and act as the center or generator. Therefore, you can promote the ability to control the body's action and master your will more easily.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: The aphorism "as a man thinketh in his heart so is he" contains the secret of life.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: The consciousness of self is the greatest hindrance to the proper execution of all physical action.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: The great mistake is to anticipate the outcome of the engagement; you ought not to be thinking of whether it ends in victory or defeat. Let nature take its course, and your tools will strike at the right moment.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: The happiness that is derived from excitement is like a brilliant fire — soon it will go out. Before we married, we never had the chance to go out to nightclubs. We only spent our nights watching TV and chatting. Many young couples live a very exciting life when they are in love. So, when they marry, and their lives are reduced to calmness and dullness, they will feel impatient and will drink the bitter cup of a sad marriage.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee
quotes.quote: The intangible represents the real power of the universe. It is the seed of the tangible.

quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.author: Cicero
quotes.quote: I prefer the most unjust peace to the justest war that was ever waged.

quotes.author: Cicero
quotes.quote: Philosophy, if rightly defined, is nothing but the love of wisdom.

quotes.author: Cicero
quotes.quote: Constant practice often excels even talent.

quotes.author: Cicero
quotes.quote: A man is least known to himself.

quotes.author: Cicero
quotes.quote: Taxes are the sinews of the state.

quotes.author: Cicero
quotes.quote: A man's real possession is his memory. In nothing else is he rich, in nothing else is he poor.

quotes.author: Cicero
quotes.quote: There never was a great soul that did not have some divine inspiration.

quotes.author: Cicero
quotes.quote: The shifts of fortune test the reliability of friends.

quotes.author: Cicero
quotes.quote: Justice extorts no reward, no kind of price; she is sought, therefore, for her own sake.

quotes.author: Claude Monet
quotes.quote: I still don't know where I am going to sleep tomorrow.

quotes.author: Claude Monet
quotes.quote: No one but myself knows the anxiety I go through and the trouble I give myself to finish paintings which do not satisfy me and seem to please so very few others.

quotes.author: Claude Monet
quotes.quote: I've always refused requests, even from friends, to employ a technique I know nothing about.

quotes.author: Claude Monet
quotes.quote: Techniques vary; art stays the same: it is a transposition of nature at once forceful and sensitive.

quotes.author: Coco Chanel
quotes.quote: In order to be irreplaceable, one must always be different.

quotes.author: Coco Chanel
quotes.quote: Don't spend time beating on a wall, hoping to transform it into a door.

quotes.author: Coco Chanel
quotes.quote: When I can no longer create anything, I'll be done for.

quotes.author: Coco Chanel
quotes.quote: Success is often achieved by those who don't know that failure is inevitable.

quotes.author: Dutch Proverb
quotes.quote: He who is outside his door has the hardest part of his journey behind him.

quotes.author: Danish Proverb
quotes.quote: Since we cannot get what we like, let us like what we can get.

quotes.author: Danish Proverb
quotes.quote: The road to a friend's house is never long.

quotes.author: Danish Proverb
quotes.quote: To the good listener, half a word is enough.

quotes.author: Danish Proverb
quotes.quote: Every person is a fool in somebody's opinion.

quotes.author: Danish Proverb
quotes.quote: Lawyers and painters can soon change white to black.

quotes.author: Danish Proverb
quotes.quote: Give to a pig when it grunts and a child when it cries, and you will have a fine pig and a bad child.

quotes.author: Dwight D. Eisenhower
quotes.quote: In preparing for battle I have always found that plans are useless, but planning is indispensable.

quotes.author: Dwight D. Eisenhower
quotes.quote: Though force can protect in emergency, only justice, fairness, consideration and cooperation can finally lead men to the dawn of eternal peace.

quotes.author: Dwight D. Eisenhower
quotes.quote: The supreme quality for leadership is unquestionably integrity. Without it, no real success is possible.

quotes.author: Dwight D. Eisenhower
quotes.quote: When you are in any contest, you should work as if there were, to the very last minute, a chance to lose it.

quotes.author: Dwight D. Eisenhower
quotes.quote: Only strength can cooperate. Weakness can only beg.

quotes.author: Dwight D. Eisenhower
quotes.quote: Pessimism never won any battle.

quotes.author: Dwight D. Eisenhower
quotes.quote: Only our individual faith in freedom can keep us free.

quotes.author: Dwight D. Eisenhower
quotes.quote: You don't lead by hitting people over the head—that's assault, not leadership.

quotes.author: Dwight D. Eisenhower
quotes.quote: A sense of humour is part of the art of leadership, of getting along with people, of getting things done.

quotes.author: Dwight D. Eisenhower
quotes.quote: May we grow in strength—without pride of self. May we, in our dealings with all peoples of the earth, ever speak truth and serve justice... May the light of freedom, coming to all darkened lands, flame brightly until at last the darkness is no more.

quotes.author: Dwight D. Eisenhower
quotes.quote: The history of free men is never really written by chance but by CHOICE — their choice.

quotes.author: Dwight D. Eisenhower
quotes.quote: Pull the string, and it will follow wherever you wish. Push it, and it will go nowhere at all.

quotes.author: Dwight D. Eisenhower
quotes.quote: An intellectual is a man who takes more words than necessary to tell more than he knows.

quotes.author: Dwight D. Eisenhower
quotes.quote: Leadership is the art of getting some one else to do something that you want done because he wants to do it.

quotes.author: Dwight D. Eisenhower
quotes.quote: People want peace so badly that governments ought to get out of their way and let them have it.

quotes.author: Dwight D. Eisenhower
quotes.quote: If all that Americans want is security, then they can go to prison. They'll have enough to eat, a bed, and a roof over their heads.

quotes.author: Dwight D. Eisenhower
quotes.quote: No easy problems ever come to the president of the United States. If they are easy to solve, somebody else has solved them.

quotes.author: Elvis Presley
quotes.quote: I have no use for bodyguards, but I have very specific use for two highly trained Certified Public Accountants.

quotes.author: Elvis Presley
quotes.quote: Ambition is a dream with a V8 engine.

quotes.author: Erasmus
quotes.quote: Everybody hates a prodigy, detests an old head on young shoulders.

quotes.author: Erasmus
quotes.quote: Man's mind is so formed that it is far more susceptible to falsehood than to truth.

quotes.author: Erasmus
quotes.quote: What difference is there, do you think, between those in plato's cave who can only marvel at the shadows and images of various objects, provided they are content and don't know what they miss, and the philosopher who has emerged from the cave and sees the real things?

quotes.author: Erasmus
quotes.quote: It is wisdom in prosperity, when all is as thou wouldst have it, to fear and suspect the worst.

quotes.author: Erasmus
quotes.quote: It is a greater advantage to be honestly educated than honorably born.

quotes.author: Erasmus
quotes.quote: The more ignorant, reckless and thoughtless a doctor is, the higher his reputation soars even amongst powerful princes.

quotes.author: Erasmus
quotes.quote: At last concluded that no creature was more miserable than man, for that all other creatures are content with those bounds that nature set them, only man endeavors to exceed them.

quotes.author: Erasmus
quotes.quote: Everyone knows that by far the happiest and universally enjoyable age of man is the first. what is there about babies which makes us hug and kiss and fondle them, so that even an enemy would give them help at that age?

quotes.author: Erasmus
quotes.quote: I consider as lovers of books not those who keep their books hidden in their store-chests and never handle them, but those who, by nightly as well as daily use thumb them, batter them, wear them out, who fill out all the margins with annotations of many kinds, and who prefer the marks of a fault they have erased to a neat copy full of faults.

quotes.author: Erasmus
quotes.quote: The most disadvantageous peace is better than the most just war.

quotes.author: Erasmus
quotes.quote: A constant element of enjoyment must be mingled with our studies, so that we think of learning as a game rather than a form of drudgery, for no activity can be continued for long if it does not to some extent afford pleasure to the participant.

quotes.author: Erasmus
quotes.quote: You must acquire the best knowledge first, and without delay; it is the height of madness to learn what you will later have to unlearn.

quotes.author: Erasmus
quotes.quote: One nail drives out another; habit is overcome by habit.

quotes.author: Erasmus
quotes.quote: If we were willing to evaluate things not according to the opinion of the crowd, but according to nature itself, how is it less repulsive to eat, chew, digest, evacuate, and sleep after the fashion of dumb animals, than to enjoy lawful and permitted carnal relations?

quotes.author: Erasmus
quotes.quote: For what is life but a play in which everyone acts a part until the curtain comes down?

quotes.author: Erasmus
quotes.quote: I doubt if a single individual could be found from the whole of mankind free from some form of insanity. the only difference is one of degree. a man who sees a gourd and takes it for his wife is called insane because this happens to very few people.

quotes.author: Erasmus
quotes.quote: It will make far less impression on the mind if you say fleeting and brief is the life of man than if you quote the proverb man is but a bubble.

quotes.author: Erasmus
quotes.quote: Many times what cannot be refuted by arguments can be parried by laughter.

quotes.author: Erasmus
quotes.quote: The nearer people approach old age the closer they return to a semblance of childhood, until the time comes for them to depart this life, again like children, neither tired of living nor aware of death.

quotes.author: Erasmus
quotes.quote: It is folly alone that stays the fugue of youth and beats off louring old age.

quotes.author: Erasmus
quotes.quote: Human affairs are so obscure and various that nothing can be clearly known.

quotes.author: Erasmus
quotes.quote: Do not be guilty of possessing a library of learned books while lacking learning yourself.

quotes.author: Erasmus
quotes.quote: In the country of the blind the one - eyed man is king.

quotes.author: Erasmus
quotes.quote: The summit of happiness is reached when a person is ready to be what he is.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: A man that seeks truth and loves it must be reckoned precious to any human society.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: What is the fruit of these teachings? Only the most beautiful and proper harvest of the truly educated—tranquility, fearlessness, and freedom. We should not trust the masses who say only the free can be educated, but rather the lovers of wisdom who say that only the educated are free.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: The proper work of the mind is the exercise of choice, refusal, yearning, repulsion, preparation, purpose, and assent. What then can pollute and clog the mind's proper functioning? Nothing but its own corrupt decisions.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Some things are in our control, while others are not. We control our opinion, choice, desire, aversion, and, in a word, everything of our own doing. We don't control our body, property, reputation, position, and, in a word, everything not of our own doing. Even more, the things in our control are by nature free, unhindered, and unobstructed, while those not in our control are weak, slavish, can be hindered, and are not our own.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: The essence of good is a certain kind of reasoned choice; just as the essence of evil is another kind. What about externals, then? They are only the raw material for our reasoned choice, which finds its own good or evil in working with them. How will it find the good? Not by marvelling at the material! For if judgements about the material are straight that makes our choices good, but if those judgements are twisted, our choices turn bad.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: For if a person shifts their caution to their own reasoned choices and the acts of those choices, they will at the same time gain the will to avoid, but if they shift their caution away from their own reasoned choices to things not under their control, seeking to avoid what is controlled by others, they will then be agitated, fearful, and unstable.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Keep this thought at the ready at daybreak, and through the day and night—there is only one path to happiness, and that is in giving up all outside of your sphere of choice, regarding nothing else as your possession, surrendering all else to God and Fortune.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: We control our reasoned choice and all acts that depend on that moral will. What's not under our control are the body and any of its parts, our possessions, parents, siblings, children, or country—anything with which we might associate.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: I am your teacher and you are learning in my school. My aim is to bring you to completion, unhindered, free from compulsive behaviour, unrestrained, without shame, free, flourishing, and happy, looking to God in things great and small—your aim is to learn and diligently practice all these things. Why then don't you complete the work, if you have the right aim and I have both the right aim and right preparation? What is missing?... The work is quite feasible, and is the only thing in our power... Let go of the past. We must only begin. Believe me and you will see.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: A podium and a prison is each a place, one high and the other low, but in either place your freedom of choice can be maintained if you so wish.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: If you wish to improve, be content to appear clueless or stupid in extraneous matters—don't wish to seem knowledgeable. And if some regard you as important, distrust yourself.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: When I see an anxious person, I ask myself, what do they want? For if a person wasn't wanting something outside of their own control, why would they be stricken by anxiety?

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Who then is invincible? The one who cannot be upset by anything outside their reasoned choice.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Keep constant guard over your perceptions, for it is no small thing you are protecting, but your respect, trustworthiness and steadiness, peace of mind, freedom from pain and fear, in a word your freedom. For what would you sell these things?

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: It is quite impossible to unite happiness with a yearning for what we don't have. Happiness has all that it wants, and resembling the well-fed, there shouldn't be hunger or thirst.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Remember that it's not only the desire for wealth and position that debases and subjugates us, but also the desire for peace, leisure, travel, and learning. It doesn't matter what the external thing is, the value we place on it subjugates us to another... where our heart is set, there our impediment lies.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Of all the things that are, some are good, others bad, and yet others indifferent. The good are virtues and all that share in them; the bad are the vices and all that indulge them; the indifferent lie in between virtue and vice and include wealth, health, life, death, pleasure, and pain.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: When children stick their hand down a narrow goody jar they can't get their full fist out and start crying. Drop a few treats and you will get it out! Curb your desire—don't set your heart on so many things and you will get what you need.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: The person is free who lives as they wish, neither compelled, nor hindered, nor limited—whose choices aren't hampered, whose desires succeed, and who don't fall into what repels them. Who wishes to live in deception—tripped up, mistaken, undisciplined, complaining, in a rut? No one. These are base people who don't live as they wish; and so, no base person is free.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: If a person gave away your body to some passerby, you'd be furious. Yet you hand over your mind to anyone who comes along, so they may abuse you, leaving it disturbed and troubled—have you no shame in that?

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: The unrestricted person, who has in hand what they will in all events, is free. But anyone who can be restricted, coerced, or pushed into something against what they will is a slave.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Whenever you find yourself blaming providence, turn it around in your mind and you will see that what has happened is in keeping with reason.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: You are not your body and hair-style, but your capacity for choosing well. If your choices are beautiful, so too will you be.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: For there are two rules to keep at the ready—that there is nothing good or bad outside my own reasoned choice, and that we shouldn't try to lead events but to follow them.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: What is it then to be properly educated? It is learning to apply our natural preconceptions to the right things according to Nature, and beyond that to separate the things that lie within our power from those that don't.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: First off, don't let the force of the impression carry you away. Say to it, 'hold up a bit and let me see who you are and where you are from—let me put you to the test'...

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: It isn't events themselves that disturb people, but only their judgements about them.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: First tell yourself what kind of person you want to be, then do what you have to do. For in nearly every pursuit we see this to be the case. Those in athletic pursuit first choose the sport they want, and then do that work.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: We don't abandon our pursuits because we despair of ever perfecting them.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: You can bind up my leg, but not even Zeus has the power to break my freedom of choice.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Don't seek for everything to happen as you wish it would, but rather wish that everything happens as it actually will—then your life will flow well.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: It is easy to praise providence for anything that may happen if you have two qualities: a complete view of what has actually happened in each instance and a sense of gratitude. Without gratitude what is the point of seeing, and without seeing what is the object of gratitude?

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Don't trust in your reputation, money, or position, but in the strength that is yours—namely, your judgments about the things that you control and don't control. For this alone is what makes us free and unfettered, that picks us up by the neck from the depths and lifts us eye to eye with the rich and powerful.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: In short, you must remember this—that if you hold anything dear outside of your own reasoned choice, you will have destroyed your capacity for choice.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: The key is to keep company only with people who uplift you, whose presence calls forth your best.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Misfortunes test friends and detect enemies.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Strengthen yourself with contentment, for it is an impregnable fortress.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: All philosophy lies in two words, sustain and abstain.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: All religions must be tolerated... for every man must get to heaven in his own way.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Be careful to leave your sons well instructed rather than rich, for the hopes of the instructed are better than the wealth of the ignorant.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Control thy passions lest they take vengence on thee.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Do not laugh much or often or unrestrainedly.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Do not seek to bring things to pass in accordance with your wishes, but wish for them as they are, and you will find them.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: First learn the meaning of what you say, and then speak.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Freedom is not procured by a full enjoyment of what is desired, but by controlling the desire.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: He is a drunkard who takes more than three glasses though he be not drunk.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: If evil be spoken of you and it be true, correct yourself, if it be a lie, laugh at it.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: If one oversteps the bounds of moderation, the greatest pleasures cease to please.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: If thy brother wrongs thee, remember not so much his wrong-doing, but more than ever that he is thy brother.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: If virtue promises happiness, prosperity and peace, then progress in virtue is progress in each of these for to whatever point the perfection of anything brings us, progress is always an approach toward it.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: If you seek truth you will not seek victory by dishonorable means, and if you find truth you will become invincible.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Imagine for yourself a character, a model personality, whose example you determine to follow, in private as well as in public.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Is freedom anything else than the right to live as we wish? Nothing else.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: It is not he who reviles or strikes you who insults you, but your opinion that these things are insulting.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: It is the nature of the wise to resist pleasures, but the foolish to be a slave to them.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: It takes more than just a good looking body. You've got to have the heart and soul to go with it.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Never in any case say I have lost such a thing, but I have returned it. Is your child dead? It is a return. Is your wife dead? It is a return. Are you deprived of your estate? Is not this also a return?

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: No great thing is created suddenly.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Nothing great is created suddenly, any more than a bunch of grapes or a fig. If you tell me that you desire a fig. I answer you that there must be time. Let it first blossom, then bear fruit, then ripen.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: One that desires to excel should endeavor in those things that are in themselves most excellent.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Only the educated are free.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Silence is safer than speech.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: The essence of philosophy is that a man should so live that his happiness shall depend as little as possible on external things.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: The two powers which in my opinion constitute a wise man are those of bearing and forbearing.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: There is nothing good or evil save in the will.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: To accuse others for one's own misfortunes is a sign of want of education. To accuse oneself shows that one's education has begun. To accuse neither oneself nor others shows that one's education is complete.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Unless we place our religion and our treasure in the same thing, religion will always be sacrificed.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: We tell lies, yet it is easy to show that lying is immoral.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Wealth consists not in having great possessions, but in having few wants.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Whenever you are angry, be assured that it is not only a present evil, but that you have increased a habit.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Whoever does not regard what he has as most ample wealth, is unhappy, though he be master of the world.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: You may be always victorious if you will never enter into any contest where the issue does not wholly depend upon yourself.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Make the best use of what's in your power and take the rest as it happens.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: A city is not adorned by external things, but by the virtue of those who dwell in it.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Adopt new habits yourself: consolidate your principles by putting them into practice.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: A guide, on finding a man who has lost his way, brings him back to the right path-he does not mock and jeer at him and then take himself off. You also must show the unlearned man the truth, and you will see that he will follow. But so long as you do not show it him, you should not mock, but rather feel your own incapacity.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: An ignorant person is inclined to blame others for his own misfortune. To blame oneself is proof of progress. But the wise man never has to blame another or himself.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: An uninstructed person will lay the fault of his own bad condition upon others. Someone just starting instruction will lay the fault on himself. Some who is perfectly instructed will place blame neither on others nor on himself.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: As a man, casting off worn out garments taketh new ones, so the dweller in the body, entereth into ones that are new.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: A ship should not ride on a single anchor, nor life on a single hope.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Asked, Who is the rich man? Epictetus replied, He who is content.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: As the sun does not wait for prayers and incantations to be induced to rise, but immediately shines and is saluted by all, so do you also not wait for clappings of hands and shouts of praise to be induced to do good, but be a doer of good voluntarily and you will be beloved as much as the sun.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Attach yourself to what is spiritually superior, regardless of what other people think or do. Hold to your true aspirations no matter what is going on around you.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Be free from grief not through insensibility like the irrational animals, nor through want of thought like the foolish, but like a man of virtue by having reason as the consolation of grief.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Be happy when you find that doctrines you have learned and analysed are being tested by real events. If you've succeeded in removing or reducing the tendency to be mean and critical, or thoughtless, or foul-mouthed, or careless, or nonchalant; if old interests no longer engage you, at least not to the same extent; then every day can be a feast day - today because you acquitted yourself well in one set of circumstances, tomorrow because of another.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Caretake this moment. Immerse yourself in its particulars. Respond to this person, this challenge, this deed. Quit the evasions. Stop giving yourself needless trouble. It is time to really live; to fully inhabit the situation you happen to be in now. You are not some disinterested bystander. Participate. Exert yourself.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Circumstances do not rise to meet our expectations. Events happen as they do. People behave as they are. Embrace what you actually get.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Circumstances don't make the man, they only reveal him to himself.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Conduct yourself in all matters, grand and public or small and domestic, in accordance with the laws of nature. Harmonizing your will with nature should be your utmost ideal.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Crows pick out the eyes of the dead, when the dead have no longer need of them; but flatterers mar the soul of the living, and her eyes they blind.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Death is not dreadful or else it would have appeared dreadful to Socrates.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Difficulty shows what men are. Therefore when a difficulty falls upon you, remember that God, like a trainer of wrestlers, has matched you with a rough young man. Why? So that you may become an Olympic conqueror; but it is not accomplished without sweat.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Does anyone bathe hastily? Do not say that they do it ill, but hastily. Does anyone drink much wine? Do not say that they do ill, but that they drink a great deal. For unless you perfectly understand their motives, how should you know if they act ill? Thus you will not risk yielding to any appearances except those you fully comprehend.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Do not afflict others with anything that you yourself would not wish to suffer. if you would not like to be a slave, make sure no one is your slave. If you have slaves, you yourself are the greatest slave, for just as freedom is incompatible with slavery, so goodness is incompatible with hypocrisy.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: [Do not get too attached to life] for it is like a sailor's leave on the shore and at any time, the captain may sound the horn, calling you back to eternal darkness.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Don't explain your philosophy. Embody it.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Don't hope that events will turn out the way you want, welcome events in whichever way they happen: this is the path to peace.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Don't live by your own rules, but in harmony with nature.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Don't put your purpose in one place and expect to see progress made somewhere else.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Either God wants to abolish evil, and cannot; or he can, but does not want to.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Events do not just happen, but arrive by appointment.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Everyone's life is a warfare, and that long and various.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Finally, when he crowns it off by becoming a senator, then he becomes a slave in fine company, then he experiences the poshest and most prestigious form of enslavement.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: For even sheep do not vomit up their grass and show to the shepherds how much they have eaten; but when they have internally digested the pasture, they produce externally wool and milk. Do you also show not your theorems to the uninstructed, but show the acts which come from their digestion.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: For I am not Eternity, but a human being-a part of the whole, as an hour is part of the day. I must come like the hour, and like the hour must pass!

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: For if we had any sense, what else should we do, both in public and in private, than sing hymns and praise the deity, and recount all the favours that he has conferred!

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: For it is not death or pain that is to be feared, but the fear of pain or death.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: For what else is tragedy than the portrayal in tragic verse of the sufferings of men who have attached high value to external things?

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: For where you find unrest, grief, fear, frustrated desire, failed aversion, jealousy and envy, happiness has no room for admittance. And where values are false, these passions inevitably follow.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Freedom is secured not by the fulfilling of men's desires, but by the removal of desire.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Freedom is the only worthy goal in life. It is won by disregarding things that lie beyond our control.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Free is the person who lives as he wishes and cannot be coerced, impeded or compelled, whose impulses cannot be thwarted, who always gets what he desires and never has to experience what he would rather avoid.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: God has entrusted me with myself. No man is free who is not master of himself. A man should so live that his happiness shall depend as little as possible on external things. The world turns aside to let any man pass who knows where he is going.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: God save me from fools with a little philosophy-no one is more difficult to reach.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Here are thieves and robbers and tribunals: and they that are called tyrants, who deem that they have after a fashion power over us, because of the miserable body and what appertains to it. Let us show them that they have power over none.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: He who exercises wisdom, exercises the knowledge which is about God.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: He who is discontented with what he has, and with what has been granted to him by fortune, is one who is ignorant of the art of living, but he who bears that in a noble spirit, and makes reasonable use of all that comes from it, deserves to be regarded as a good man.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: He who laughs at himself never runs out of things to laugh at.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: If any be unhappy, let him remember that he is unhappy by reason of himself alone. For God hath made all men to enjoy felicity and constancy of good.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: If anyone tells you that a certain person speaks ill of you, do not make excuses about what is said of you but answer, "He was ignorant of my other faults, else he would not have mentioned these alone."

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: If they are wise, do not quarrel with them; if they are fools, ignore them.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: If you choose, you are free; if you choose, you need blame no man-accuse no man. All things will be at once according to your mind and according to the Mind of God.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: If you ever happen to turn your attention to externals, for the pleasure of any one, be assured that you have ruined your scheme of life. Be contented, then, in everything, with being a philosopher; and if you with to seem so likewise to any one, appear so to yourself, and it will suffice you.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: If you have assumed a character above your strength, you have both acted in this matter in an unbecoming way, and you have neglected that which you might have fulfilled.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: If you want to improve, be content to be thought foolish and stupid with regard to external things. Don't wish to be thought to know anything; and even if you appear to be somebody important to others, distrust yourself. For, it is difficult to both keep your faculty of choice in a state conformable to nature, and at the same time acquire external things. But while you are careful about the one, you must of necessity neglect the other.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: If you wish it, you are free; if you wish it, you'll find fault with no one, you'll cast blame on no one, and everything that comes about will do so in accordance with your own will and that of God.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: If you wish to be good, first believe that you are bad.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: If you wish your house to be well managed, imitate the Spartan Lycurgus. For as he did not fence his city with walls, but fortified the inhabitants by virtue and preserved the city always free; so do you not cast around (your house) a large court and raise high towers, but strengthen the dwellers by good-will and fidelity and friendship, and then nothing harmful will enter it, not even if the whole band of wickedness shall array itself against it.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: If you would cure anger, do not feed it. Say to yourself: 'I used to be angry every day; then every other day; now only every third or fourth day.' When you reach thirty days offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving to the gods.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: I laugh at those who think they can damage me. They do not know who I am, they do not know what I think, they cannot even touch the things which are really mine and with which I live.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: I must die. Must I then die lamenting? I must be put in chains. Must I then also lament? I must go into exile. Does any man then hinder me from going with smiles and cheerfulness and contentment?

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: In banquets remember that you entertain two guests, body and soul: and whatever you shall have given to the body you soon eject: but what you shall have given to the soul, you keep always.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: In literature, too, it is not great achievement to memorize what you have read while not formulating an opinion of your own.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Is then the fruit of a fig-tree not perfect suddenly and in one hour, and would you possess the fruit of a man's mind in so short a time and so easily?

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: It has been ordained that there be summer and winter, abundance and dearth, virtue and vice, and all such opposites for the harmony of the whole, and (Zeus) has given each of us a body, property, and companions.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: It is always our choice whether or not we wish to pay the price for life's rewards. And often it is best for us not to pay the price, for the price might be our integrity.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: It is a universal law - have no illusion - that every creature alive is attached to nothing so much as to its own self-interest.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: It is better to die of hunger having lived without grief and fear, than to live with a troubled spirit, amid abundance.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: It is better to do wrong seldom and to own it, and to act right for the most part, than seldom to admit that you have done wrong and to do wrong often.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: It is our attitude toward events, not events themselves, which we can control. Nothing is by its own nature calamitous - even death is terrible only if we fear it.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: It is possible to learn the will of nature from the things in which we do not differ from each other. For example, when someone else's little slave boy breaks his cup we are ready to say, "It's one of those things that just happen." Certainly, then, when your own cup is broken you should be just the way you were when the other person's was broken. Transfer the same idea to larger matters. Someone else's child is dead, or his wife. There is no one would not say, "It's the lot of a human being." But when one's own dies, immediately it is, "Alas! Poor me!" But we should have remembered how we feel when we hear of the same thing about others.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: It is unrealistic to expect people to see you as you see yourself.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Keep the prospect of death, exile and all such apparent tragedies before you every day - especially death - and you will never have an abject thought, or desire anything to excess.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Know you not that a good man does nothing for appearance sake, but for the sake of having done right?

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Let silence be your general rule; or say only what is necessary and in few words.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Let your will to avoid have no concern with what is not in man's power; direct it only to things in man's power that are contrary to nature.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Man is troubled not by events, but by the meaning he gives to them.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Many people who have progressively lowered their personal standards in an attempt to win social acceptance and life's comforts bitterly resent those of philosophical bent who refuse to compromise their spiritual ideals and who seek to better themselves.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Men are disturbed not by the things that happen, but by their opinion of the things that happen.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Most of what passes for legitimate entertainment is inferior or foolish and only caters to or exploits people's weaknesses. Avoid being one of the mob who indulges in such pastimes. Your life is too short and you have important things to do. Be discriminating about what images and ideas you permit into your mind. If you yourself don't choose what thoughts and images you expose yourself to, someone else will, and their motives may not be the highest. It is the easiest thing in the world to slide imperceptibly into vulgarity. But there's no need for that to happen if you determine not to waste your time and attention on mindless pap.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Nature hath given men one tongue but two ears, that we may hear from others twice as much as we speak.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Never depend on the admiration of others. There is no strength in it. Personal merit cannot be derived from an external source. It is not to be found in your personal associations, nor can it be found in the regard of other people. It is a fact of life that other people, even people who love you, will not necessarily agree with your ideas, understand you, or share your enthusiasms. Grow up! Who cares what other people think about you!

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Never praise or blame people on common grounds; look to their judgements exclusively. Because that is the determining factor, which makes everyone's actions either good or bad.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Never say about anything, I have lost it, but only I have given it back.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: No one is ever unhappy because of someone else.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Now is the time to get serious about living your ideals. How long can you afford to put off who you really want to be? Your nobler self cannot wait any longer. Put your principles into practice - now. Stop the excuses and the procrastination. This is your life! You aren't a child anymore. The sooner you set yourself to your spiritual program, the happier you will be. The longer you wait, the more you'll be vulnerable to mediocrity and feel filled with shame and regret, because you know you are capable of better. From this instant on, vow to stop disappointing yourself. Separate yourself from the mob. Decide to be extraordinary and do what you need to do - now.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: On the occasion of every accident that befalls you, remember to turn to yourself and inquire what power you have for turning it to use.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Other people's views and troubles can be contagious. Don't sabotage yourself by unwittingly adopting negative, unproductive attitudes through your associations with others.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Preach not to others what they should eat, but eat as becomes you and be silent.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Protect what belongs to you at all costs; don't desire what belongs to another.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Reading should serve the goal of attaining peace; if it doesn't make you peaceful, what good is it?

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Remember from now on whenever something tends to make you unhappy, draw on this principle: 'This is no misfortune; but bearing with it bravely is a blessing.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Remember that you ought to behave in life as you would at a banquet. As something is being passed around it comes to you; stretch out your hand, take a portion of it politely. It passes on; do not detain it. Or it has not come to you yet; do not project your desire to meet it, but wait until it comes in front of you. So act toward children, so toward a wife, so toward office, so toward wealth.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Remember to act always as if you were at a symposium. When the food or drink comes around, reach out and take some politely; if it passes you by don't try pulling it back. And if it has not reached you yet, don't let your desire run ahead of you, be patient until your turn comes. Adopt a similar attitude with regard to children, wife, wealth and status, and in time, you will be entitled to dine with the gods. Go further and decline these goods even when they are on offer and you will have a share in the gods' power as well as their company. That is how Diogenes, Heraclitus and philosophers like them came to be called, and considered, divine.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Restrict yourself to choice and refusal; and exercise them carefully, with discipline and detachment.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Seek not the good in external things; seek it in yourselves.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Sickness is a problem for the body, not the mind - unless the mind decides that it is a problem. Lameness, too, is the body's problem, not the mind's. Say this to yourself whatever the circumstance and you will find without fail that the problem pertains to something else, not to you.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Small-minded people blame others. Average people blame themselves. The wise see all blame as foolishness.

quotes.author: Epictetus
