quotes.quote: So don't make a show of your philosophical learning to the uninitiated, show them by your actions what you have absorbed.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: So if you like doing something, do it regularly; if you don't like doing something, make a habit of doing something different.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: So what oppresses and scares us? It is our own thoughts, obviously, What overwhelms people when they are about to leaves friends, family, old haunts and their accustomed way of life? Thoughts.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: So you wish to conquer in the Olympic Games, my friend? And I, too... But first mark the conditions and the consequences. You will have to put yourself under discipline; to eat by rule, to avoid cakes and sweetmeats; to take exercise at the appointed hour whether you like it or not, in cold and heat; to abstain from cold drinks and wine at your will. Then, in the conflict itself you are likely enough to dislocate your wrist or twist your ankle, to swallow a great deal of dust, to be severely thrashed, and after all of these things, to be defeated.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Take care not to hurt the ruling faculty of your mind. If you were to guard against this in every action, you should enter upon those actions more safely.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Tentative efforts lead to tentative outcomes. Therefore, give yourself fully to your endeavors. Decide to construct your character through excellent actions and determine to pay the price of a worthy goal. The trials you encounter will introduce you to your strengths. Remain steadfast and one day you will build something that endures: something worthy of your potential.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: The condition and characteristic of an uninstructed person is this: he never expects from himself profit (advantage) nor harm, but from externals. The condition and characteristic of a philosopher is this: he expects all advantage and all harm from himself.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: The gods do not exists, and even if they exist they do not trouble themselves about people, and we have nothing in common with them. The piety and devotion to the gods that the majority of people invoke is a lie devised by swindlers and con men and, if you can believe it, by legislators, to keep criminals in line by putting the fear of God into them.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: The greater the difficulty, the more glory in surmounting it. Skillful pilots gain their reputation from storms and tempests.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: The more we value things outside our control, the less control we have.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: The philosopher's school, ye men, is a surgery: you ought not to go out of it with pleasure, but with pain. For you are not in sound health when you enter.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: There is a time and place for diversion and amusements, but you should never allow them to override your true purposes.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: There is but one way to tranquility of mind and happiness, and that is to account no external things thine own, but to commit all to God.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: There is no shame in making an honest effort.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: These reasoning's do not cohere: I am richer than you, therefore I am better than you; I am more eloquent than you, therefore I am better than you. On the contrary these rather cohere, I am richer than you, therefore my possessions are greater than yours: I am more eloquent than you, therefore my speech is superior to yours. But you are neither possession nor speech.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: To admonish is better than to reproach for admonition is mild and friendly, but reproach is harsh and insulting; and admonition corrects those who are doing wrong, but reproach only convicts them.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: To Epictetus, all external events are determined by fate, and are thus beyond our control, but we can accept whatever happens calmly and dispassionately. Individuals, however, are responsible for their own actions which they can examine and control through rigorous self-discipline. Suffering arises from trying to control what is uncontrollable, or from neglecting what is within our power. As part of the universal city that is the universe, human beings have a duty of care to all fellow humans. The person who followed these precepts would achieve happiness.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Very little is needed for everything to be upset and ruined, only a slight lapse in reason.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: We are at the mercy of whoever wields authority over the things we either desire or detest. If you would be free, then, do not wish to have, or avoid, things that other people control, because then you must serve as their slave.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: We are not disturbed by what happens to us, but by our thoughts about what happens to us.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: We cannot choose our external circumstances, but we can always choose how we respond to them.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: We should realize that an opinion is not easily formed unless a person says and hears the same things every day and practises them in real life.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: What are we to do, then? To make the best of what lies within our power, and deal with everything else as it comes. 'How does it come, then?' As God wills.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: What concerns me is not the way things are, but the way people think things are.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: What you shun enduring yourself, attempt not to impose on others. You shun slavery - beware enslaving others! If you can endure to do that, one would think you had been once upon a time a slave yourself. For vice has nothing in common with virtue, nor Freedom with slavery.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: When a youth was giving himself airs in the Theatre and saying, 'I am wise, for I have conversed with many wise men,' Epictetus replied, 'I too have conversed with many rich men, yet I am not rich!'.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Whenever anyone criticizes or wrongs you, remember that they are only doing or saying what they think is right. They cannot be guided by your views, only their own; so if their views are wrong, they are the ones who suffer insofar as they are misguided.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: When then any man assents to that which is false, be assured that he did not intend to assent to it as false, for every soul is unwillingly deprived of the truth, as Plato says; but the falsity seemed to him to be true.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: When things seem to have reached that stage, merely say "I won't play any longer", and take your departure; but if you stay, stop lamenting.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: When you do anything from a clear judgment that it ought to be done, never shun the being seen to do it, even though the world should make a wrong supposition about it; for, if you don't act right, shun the action itself; but, if you do, why are you afraid of those who censure you wrongly?

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Wherever I go it will be well with me, for it was well with me here, not on account of the place, but of my judgments which I shall carry away with me, for no one can deprive me of these; on the contrary, they alone are my property, and cannot be taken away, and to possess them suffices me wherever I am or whatever I do.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Who are those people by whom you wish to be admired? Are they not these whom you are in the habit of saying that they are mad? What then? Do you wish to be admired by the mad?

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Whoever is going to listen to the philosophers needs a considerable practice in listening.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Whoever then would be free, let him wish for nothing, let him decline nothing, which depends on others; else he must necessarily be a slave.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Who is your master? Whoever has authority over anything that you're anxious to gain or avoid.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: You become what you give your attention to.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: You know yourself what you are worth in your own eyes; and at what price you will sell yourself. For men sell themselves at various prices. This is why, when Florus was deliberating whether he should appear at Nero's shows, taking part in the performance himself, Agrippinus replied, 'Appear by all means.' And when Florus inquired, 'But why do not you appear?' he answered, 'Because I do not even consider the question.' For the man who has once stooped to consider such questions, and to reckon up the value of external things, is not far from forgetting what manner of man he is.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: You may fetter my leg, but Zeus himself cannot get the better of my free will.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: You ought to realize, you take up very little space in the world as a whole-your body, that is; in reason, however, you yield to no one, not even to the gods, because reason is not measured in size but sense. So why not care for that side of you, where you and the gods are equals?

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Your happiness depends on three things, all of which are within your power: your will, your ideas concerning the events in which you are involved, and the use you make of your ideas.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: You should be especially careful when associating with one of your former friends or acquaintances not to sink to their level; otherwise you will lose yourself. If you are troubled by the idea that He'll think I'm boring and won't treat me the way he used to, remember that everything comes at a price. It isn't possible to change your behavior and still be the same person you were before.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: You will do the greatest services to the state, if you shall raise not the roofs of the houses, but the souls of the citizens: for it is better that great souls should dwell in small houses than for mean slaves to lurk in great houses.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: You will never have to experience defeat if you avoid contests whose outcome is outside your control.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.quote: Not things, but opinions about things, trouble men.

quotes.author: Elon Musk
quotes.quote: I think it is a mistake to hire huge numbers of people to get a complicated job done. Numbers will never compensate for talent in getting the right answer (two people who don't know something are no better than one), will tend to slow down progress, and will make the task incredibly expensive.

quotes.author: Elon Musk
quotes.quote: I think that is a mistake and results in cloudy judgment on important technical issues. They can't tell if something is really good or not, so they just do what everyone else does, assuming it to be the safe bet.

quotes.author: Elon Musk
quotes.quote: I think the reason it's cheaper is, first of all, we are a private entity and we have a very lean system in here. What we have been able to do here at SpaceX is to cherry-pick, you know, the top one or two percent and give them, you know, capital to execute well and a clear mission, which is low cost, reliable access to space, and no other constraints.

quotes.author: Elon Musk
quotes.quote: I think the rocket business is quite cyclic. There are a great many peaks and troughs.

quotes.author: Elon Musk
quotes.quote: If nothing else, we are committed to failing in a new way.

quotes.author: Elon Musk
quotes.quote: Imagine creating a huge software program that can only be tested in little pieces on a computer that is slightly different from what it is supposed to run on. However, when you do run it as a whole on the actual computer for the first time, it must run almost flawlessly without a single significant bug. When is the last time you saw a software program do that?

quotes.author: Elon Musk
quotes.quote: We're adding a triple sign-off for all work done on the launch pad, on flight components, and flight critical GSE. You have a technician, a responsible engineer, and then quality assurance will sign the final, record all information, and take photographs of all the work that was done, and then make sure that all information is put into our quality assurance database, which is reviewed prior to launch.

quotes.author: Elon Musk
quotes.quote: Well, I have tried to learn as much as possible from prior attempts.

quotes.author: Elon Musk
quotes.quote: When Henry Ford made cheap, reliable cars people said, 'Nah, what's wrong with a horse?' That was a huge bet he made, and it worked.

quotes.author: Elon Musk
quotes.quote: When thinking about starting a business, I think it's actually better to start in a trough and come to market in a peak, than the other way around. Frankly, if anything does, and it's almost cliché, space has a long-term future.

quotes.author: Edgar Allan Poe
quotes.quote: Art is the reproduction of what the senses perceive in through the veil of the soul.

quotes.author: Edgar Allan Poe
quotes.quote: The angels... singing unto one another, Can find among their burning terms of love, None so devotional as that of "mother".

quotes.author: Edgar Allan Poe
quotes.quote: Poetry is the rhythmical creation of beauty in words.

quotes.author: Edgar Allan Poe
quotes.quote: Of puns it has been said that those who most dislike are least able to utter them.

quotes.author: Edgar Allan Poe
quotes.quote: All that we see or seem\nIs but a dream within a dream.

quotes.author: French Proverb
quotes.quote: Everyone thinks his own burden is heavy.

quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
quotes.quote: What is hell? I maintain that it is the suffering of being unable to love.

quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
quotes.quote: The darker the night, the brighter the stars, The deeper the grief, the closer is God!

quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
quotes.quote: People speak sometimes about the "bestial" cruelty of man, but that is terribly unjust and offensive to beasts, no animal could ever be so cruel as a man, so artfully, so artistically cruel.

quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
quotes.quote: Nothing in this world is harder than speaking the truth, nothing easier than flattery.

quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
quotes.quote: Taking a new step, uttering a new word, is what people fear most.

quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
quotes.quote: The awful thing is that beauty is mysterious as well as terrible. God and the devil are fighting there and the battlefield is the heart of man.

quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
quotes.quote: The cleverest of all, in my opinion, is the man who calls himself a fool at least once a month.

quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
quotes.quote: The degree of civilization in a society can be judged by entering its prisons.

quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
quotes.quote: It's the great mystery of human life that old grief passes gradually into quiet tender joy.

quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
quotes.quote: Love a man, even in his sin, for that love is a likeness of the divine love, and is the summit of love on earth.

quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
quotes.quote: The greatest happiness is to know the source of unhappiness.

quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
quotes.quote: Destroy my desires, eradicate my ideas, show me something better, and I will follow you.

quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
quotes.quote: A fool with a heart and no sense is just as unhappy as a fool with sense and no heart.

quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
quotes.quote: If he's honest, he'll steal; if he's human, he'll murder; if he's faithful, he'll deceive.

quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
quotes.quote: Truly great men must, I think, experience great sorrow on the earth.

quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
quotes.quote: When reason fails, the devil helps!

quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
quotes.quote: The mystery of human existence lies not in just staying alive, but in finding something to live for.

quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
quotes.quote: If someone proved to me that Christ is outside the truth, and that in reality the truth were outside of Christ, then I should prefer to remain with Christ rather than with the truth.

quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
quotes.quote: What do you think, would not one tiny crime be wiped out by thousands of good deeds?

quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
quotes.quote: Every ant knows the formula of its ant-hill, every bee knows the formula of its beehive. They know it in their own way, not in our way. Only humankind does not know its own formula.

quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
quotes.quote: Grown-up people do not know that a child can give exceedingly good advice even in the most difficult case.

quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
quotes.quote: Life is paradise, and we are all in paradise, but we refuse to see it.

quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
quotes.quote: Neither man nor nation can exist without a sublime idea.

quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
quotes.quote: Compassion was the most important, perhaps the sole law of human existence.

quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
quotes.quote: I believe the best definition of man is the ungrateful biped.

quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
quotes.quote: If you can put the question "Am I or am I not responsible for my acts?" then you are responsible.

quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
quotes.quote: We are all happy if we only knew it.

quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
quotes.quote: So long as man remains free he strives for nothing so incessantly and so painfully as to find someone to worship.

quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
quotes.quote: If the Devil doesn't exist, but man has created him, he has created him in his own likeness.

quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
quotes.quote: It takes something more than intelligence to act intelligently.

quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
quotes.quote: Beauty will save the world.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: It is not a lack of love, but a lack of friendship that makes unhappy marriages.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: What someone is, begins to be revealed when his talent abates, when he stops showing us what he can do.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: In the end we are always rewarded for our good will, our patience, fair-mindedness, and gentleness with what is strange.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Morality is the best of all devices for leading mankind by the nose.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Necessity is an interpretation, not a fact.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Man is the cruelest animal.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: A good writer possesses not only his own spirit but also the spirit of his friends.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: It is hard enough to remember my opinions, without also remembering my reasons for them!

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: The surest way to corrupt a youth is to instruct him to hold in higher esteem those who think alike than those who think differently.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: What does your conscience say? — 'You should become the person you are'.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: All I need is a sheet of paper and something to write with, and then I can turn the world upside down.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: In heaven, all the interesting people are missing.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: The individual has always had to struggle to keep from being overwhelmed by the tribe. If you try it, you will be lonely often, and sometimes frightened. But no price is too high to pay for the privilege of owning yourself.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Sometimes people don't want to hear the truth because they don't want their illusions destroyed.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: The man of knowledge must be able not only to love his enemies but also to hate his friends.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: I cannot believe in a God who wants to be praised all the time.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: The advantage of a bad memory is that one enjoys several times the same good things for the first time.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Faith: not wanting to know what the truth is.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: What labels me, negates me.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: He who would learn to fly one day must first learn to walk and run and climb and dance; one cannot fly into flying.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: There are two different types of people in the world, those who want to know, and those who want to believe.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: At bottom every man knows well enough that he is a unique being, only once on this earth; and by no extraordinary chance will such a marvellously picturesque piece of diversity in unity as he is, ever be put together a second time.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: What is evil – Whatever springs from weakness.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Better know nothing than half know many things.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Man alone suffers so excruciatingly in the world that he was compelled to invent laughter.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Man is a rope connecting animal and superman – a rope over a precipice... What is great in man is that he is a bridge and not a goal.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Nobody knows what news is important until a hundred years after wards.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Wherever I found a living creature, there I found the will to power.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: A thought is only a sign just as a world is only a sign of a thought.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Making music is another way of making children.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: At the beginning of a marriage ask yourself whether this woman will be interesting to talk to from now until old age.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Every extension of knowledge arises from making the conscious the unconscious.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Truth is the kind of error without which a certain species of life could not live. What ultimately counts is the value for life.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Is not life a hundred times too short for us to bore ourselves?

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: 'Evil men have no songs.' How is it that the Russians have songs?

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: A friend should be a master at guessing and keeping still: you must not want to see everything.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: A great value of antiquity lies in the fact that its writings are the only ones that modern men still read with exactness.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: A pair of powerful spectacles has sometimes sufficed to cure a person in love.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: A woman may very well form a friendship with a man, but for this to endure, it must be assisted by a little physical antipathy.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Ah, women. They make the highs higher and the lows more frequent.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: All sciences are now under the obligation to prepare the ground for the future task of the philosopher, which is to solve the problem of value, to determine the true hierarchy of values.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: All things are subject to interpretation whichever interpretation prevails at a given time is a function of power and not truth.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: All truly great thoughts are conceived by walking.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Although the most acute judges of the witches and even the witches themselves, were convinced of the guilt of witchery, the guilt nevertheless was non-existent. It is thus with all guilt.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: An artist has no home in Europe except in Paris.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Anyone who has declared someone else to be an idiot, a bad apple, is annoyed when it turns out in the end that he isn't.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Arrogance on the part of the meritorious is even more offensive to us than the arrogance of those without merit: for merit itself is offensive.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Art is not merely an imitation of the reality of nature, but in truth a metaphysical supplement to the reality of nature, placed alongside thereof for its conquest.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Art raises its head where creeds relax.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Before the effect one believes in different causes than one does after the effect.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Blessed are the forgetful: for they get the better even of their blunders.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Character is determined more by the lack of certain experiences than by those one has had.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Every man is a creative cause of what happens, a primum mobile with an original movement.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Existence really is an imperfect tense that never becomes a present.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Experience, as a desire for experience, does not come off. We must not study ourselves while having an experience.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Extreme positions are not succeeded by moderate ones, but by contrary extreme positions.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Fear is the mother of morality.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: For art to exist, for any sort of aesthetic activity to exist, a certain physiological precondition is indispensable: intoxication.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Genteel women suppose that those things do not really exist about which it is impossible to talk in polite company.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Glance into the world just as though time were gone: and everything crooked will become straight to you.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Go up close to your friend, but do not go over to him! We should also respect the enemy in our friend.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: God is a thought who makes crooked all that is straight.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Great indebtedness does not make men grateful, but vengeful; and if a little charity is not forgotten, it turns into a gnawing worm.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: He that humbleth himself wishes to be exalted.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: He who cannot give anything away cannot feel anything either.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: He who fights with monsters might take care lest he thereby become a monster. Is not life a hundred times too short for us to bore ourselves?

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: He who has a why to live can bear almost any how.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Hope in reality is the worst of all evils because it prolongs the torments of man.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: I assess the power of a will by how much resistance, pain, torture it endures and knows how to turn to its advantage.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: I do not know what the spirit of a philosopher could more wish to be than a good dancer. For the dance is his ideal, also his fine art, finally also the only kind of piety he knows, his "divine service."

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: I love those who do not know how to live for today.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: I still live, I still think: I still have to live, for I still have to think.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: I would believe only in a God that knows how to Dance.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Idleness is the parent of psychology.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: If a woman possesses manly virtues one should run away from her; and if she does not possess them she runs away from herself.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: In Christianity neither morality nor religion come into contact with reality at any point.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: In every real man a child is hidden that wants to play.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: In everything one thing is impossible: rationality.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: In large states public education will always be mediocre, for the same reason that in large kitchens the cooking is usually bad.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: In praise there is more obtrusiveness than in blame.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: In the consciousness of the truth he has perceived, man now sees everywhere only the awfulness or the absurdity of existence and loathing seizes him.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: In the course of history, men come to see that iron necessity is neither iron nor necessary.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: In the last analysis, even the best man is evil: in the last analysis, even the best woman is bad.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: It is good to express a thing twice right at the outset and so to give it a right foot and also a left one. Truth can surely stand on one leg, but with two it will be able to walk and get around.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: It is impossible to suffer without making someone pay for it; every complaint already contains revenge.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: It is my ambition to say in ten sentences what others say in a whole book.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: It is not when truth is dirty, but when it is shallow, that the lover of knowledge is reluctant to step into its waters.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: It is the most sensual men who need to flee women and torment their bodies.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: It says nothing against the ripeness of a spirit that it has a few worms.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Judgments, value judgments concerning life, for or against, can in the last resort never be true: they possess value only as symptoms, they come into consideration only as symptoms - in themselves such judgments are stupidities.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Let us beware of saying that death is the opposite of life. The living being is only a species of the dead, and a very rare species.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Love is not consolation. It is light.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Many a man fails as an original thinker simply because his memory it too good.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Many are stubborn in pursuit of the path they have chosen, few in pursuit of the goal.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Mystical explanations are thought to be deep; the truth is that they are not even shallow.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: No one lies so boldly as the man who is indignant.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Not necessity, not desire - no, the love of power is the demon of men. Let them have everything - health, food, a place to live, entertainment - they are and remain unhappy and low-spirited: for the demon waits and waits and will be satisfied.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Nothing has been purchased more dearly than the little bit of reason and sense of freedom which now constitutes our pride.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Nothing is beautiful, only man: on this piece of naivete rests all aesthetics, it is the first truth of aesthetics. Let us immediately add its second: nothing is ugly but degenerate man - the domain of aesthetic judgment is therewith defined.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Of all that is written, I love only what a person has written with his own blood.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: On the mountains of truth you can never climb in vain: either you will reach a point higher up today, or you will be training your powers so that you will be able to climb higher tomorrow.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: One has to pay dearly for immortality; one has to die several times while one is still alive.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: One often contradicts an opinion when what is uncongenial is really the tone in which it was conveyed.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: One ought to hold on to one's heart; for if one lets it go, one soon loses control of the head too.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: One should die proudly when it is no longer possible to live proudly.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Our treasure lies in the beehive of our knowledge. We are perpetually on the way thither, being by nature winged insects and honey gatherers of the mind.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Our vanity is hardest to wound precisely when our pride has just been wounded.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: People who have given us their complete confidence believe that they have a right to ours. The inference is false, a gift confers no rights.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Rejoicing in our joy, not suffering over our suffering, makes someone a friend.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Shared joys make a friend, not shared sufferings.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Some are made modest by great praise, others insolent.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Stupid as a man, say the women: cowardly as a woman, say the men. Stupidity in a woman is unwomanly.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Success has always been a great liar.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Talking much about oneself can also be a means to conceal oneself.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: The "kingdom of Heaven" is a condition of the heart - not something that comes "upon the earth" or "after death."

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: The abdomen is the reason why man does not readily take himself to be a god.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: The aphorism in which I am the first master among Germans, are the forms of "eternity"; my ambition is to say in ten sentences what everyone else says in a book - what everyone else does not say in a book.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: The bad gains respect through imitation, the good loses it especially in art.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: The best author will be the one who is ashamed to become a writer.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: The best weapon against an enemy is another enemy.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: The demand to be loved is the greatest of all arrogant presumptions.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: The future influences the present just as much as the past.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: The irrationality of a thing is no argument against its existence, rather a condition of it.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: The lie is a condition of life.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: The most common lie is that which one lies to himself; lying to others is relatively an exception.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: The press, the machine, the railway, the telegraph are premises whose thousand-year conclusion no one has yet dared to draw.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: The true man wants two things: danger and play. For that reason he wants woman, as the most dangerous plaything.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: The word "Christianity" is already a misunderstanding - in reality there has been only one Christian, and he died on the Cross.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: The world itself is the will to power - and nothing else! And you yourself are the will to power - and nothing else!

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: There are horrible people who, instead of solving a problem, tangle it up and make it harder to solve for anyone who wants to deal with it. Whoever does not know how to hit the nail on the head should be asked not to hit it at all.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: There are no eternal facts, as there are no absolute truths.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: There are people who want to make men's lives more difficult for no other reason than the chance it provides them afterwards to offer their prescription for alleviating life; their Christianity, for instance.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: There are slavish souls who carry their appreciation for favors done them so far that they strangle themselves with the rope of gratitude.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: There are various eyes. Even the Sphinx has eyes: and as a result there are various truths, and as a result there is no truth.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: There is a rollicking kindness that looks like malice.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: There is an innocence in admiration; it is found in those to whom it has never yet occurred that they, too, might be admired some day.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: There is in general good reason to suppose that in several respects the gods could all benefit from instruction by us human beings. We humans are - more humane.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: There is more wisdom in your body than in your deepest philosophy.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: There is not enough love and goodness in the world to permit giving any of it away to imaginary beings.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: There is not enough religion in the world even to destroy religion.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: There is nothing we like to communicate to others as much as the seal of secrecy together with what lies under it.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: This is what is hardest: to close the open hand because one loves.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Those who cannot understand how to put their thoughts on ice should not enter into the heat of debate.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: To be ashamed of one's immorality: that is a step on the staircase at whose end one is also ashamed of one's morality.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: To forget one's purpose is the commonest form of stupidity.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: To live is to suffer, to survive is to find some meaning in the suffering.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: To use the same words is not a sufficient guarantee of understanding; one must use the same words for the same genus of inward experience; ultimately one must have one's experiences in common.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Today I love myself as I love my god: who could charge me with a sin today? I know only sins against my god; but who knows my god?

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Undeserved praise causes more pangs of conscience later than undeserved blame, but probably only for this reason, that our power of judgment are more completely exposed by being over praised than by being unjustly underestimated.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: War has always been the grand sagacity of every spirit which has grown too inward and too profound; its curative power lies even in the wounds one receives.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: We do not hate as long as we still attach a lesser value, but only when we attach an equal or a greater value.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: We hear only those questions for which we are in a position to find answers.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: We love life, not because we are used to living but because we are used to loving.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: We often refuse to accept an idea merely because the tone of voice in which it has been expressed is unsympathetic to us.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: We should consider every day lost on which we have not danced at least once. And we should call every truth false which was not accompanied by at least one laugh.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: What can everyone do? Praise and blame. This is human virtue, this is human madness.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: What do I care about the purring of one who cannot love, like the cat?

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: What do you regard as most humane? To spare someone shame.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: What is good? All that heightens the feeling of power, the will to power, power itself in man.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: What then in the last resort are the truths of mankind? They are the irrefutable errors of mankind.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: What? You seek something? You wish to multiply yourself tenfold, a hundredfold? You seek followers? Seek zeros!

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: When art dresses in worn-out material it is most easily recognized as art.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: When marrying, ask yourself this question: Do you believe that you will be able to converse well with this person into your old age? Everything else in marriage is transitory.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: When one does away with oneself one does the most estimable thing possible: one thereby almost deserves to live.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: When one has a great deal to put into it a day has a hundred pockets.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: When one has finished building one's house, one suddenly realizes that in the process one has learned something that one really needed to know in the worst way - before one began.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: When you look into an abyss, the abyss also looks into you.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Whenever I climb I am followed by a dog called 'Ego'.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Whoever battles with monsters had better see that it does not turn him into a monster. And if you gaze long into an abyss, the abyss will gaze back into you.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Whoever despises himself nonetheless respects himself as one who despises.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Whoever does not have a good father should procure one.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Whoever feels predestined to see and not to believe will find all believers too noisy and pushy: he guards against them.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Whoever has provoked men to rage against him has always gained a party in his favor, too.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Whoever has witnessed another's ideal becomes his inexorable judge and as it were his evil conscience.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Wit is the epitaph of an emotion.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Women are considered deep - why? Because one can never discover any bottom to them. Women are not even shallow.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Words are but symbols for the relations of things to one another and to us; nowhere do they touch upon absolute truth.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: You say it is the good cause that hallows even war? I say unto you: it is the good war that hallows any cause.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Happiness is the feeling that power increases — that resistance is being overcome.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Believe me! The secret of reaping the greatest fruitfulness and the greatest enjoyment from life is to live dangerously!

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: In every party there is one person who, by his all-too-devout enunciation of party principles, provokes the other members to defect.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: There is no more dangerous error than that of mistaking the effect for the cause: I call it the real corruption of reason.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: Art is essentially the affirmation, the blessing, and the deification of existence.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: There is one thing one has to have: either a soul that is cheerful by nature, or a soul made cheerful by work, love, art, and knowledge.

quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
quotes.quote: We have art so that we may not perish by the truth.

quotes.author: Galileo Galilei
quotes.quote: You cannot teach a man anything; you can only help him to find it within himself.

quotes.author: Galileo Galilei
quotes.quote: The sun, with all those planets revolving around it and dependent upon it, can still ripen a bunch of grapes as if it had nothing else in the universe to do.

quotes.author: Galileo Galilei
quotes.quote: But of all other stupendous inventions, what sublimity of mind must have been his who conceived how to communicate his most secret thoughts to any other person, though very far distant either in time or place? And with no greater difficulty than the various arrangement of two dozen little signs upon paper? Let this be the seal of all the admirable inventions of man.

quotes.author: Galileo Galilei
quotes.quote: Doubt is the father of invention.

quotes.author: Galileo Galilei
quotes.quote: I do not feel obliged to believe that the same God who has endowed us with sense, reason, and intellect has intended us to forgo their use.

quotes.author: Galileo Galilei
quotes.quote: Infinities and indivisibles transcend our finite understanding, the former on account of their magnitude, the latter because of their smallness; Imagine what they are when combined.

quotes.author: Galileo Galilei
quotes.quote: The difficulties in the study of the infinite arise because we attempt, with our finite minds, to discuss the infinite, assigning to it those properties which we give to the finite and limited; but this...is wrong, for we cannot speak of infinite quantities as being the one greater or less than or equal to another.

quotes.author: Galileo Galilei
quotes.quote: The intention of the Holy Ghost is to teach us how one goes to heaven, not how heaven goes.

quotes.author: Galileo Galilei
quotes.quote: The laws of Nature are written in the language of mathematics...the symbols are triangles, circles and other geometrical figures, without whose help it is impossible to comprehend a single word.

quotes.author: Galileo Galilei
quotes.quote: In questions of science, the writerity of a thousand is not worth the humble reasoning of a single individual.

quotes.author: George S. Patton
quotes.quote: You must be single-minded. Drive for the one thing on which you have decided.

quotes.author: George S. Patton
quotes.quote: If everyone is thinking alike then somebody isn't thinking.

quotes.author: George S. Patton
quotes.quote: I don't measure a man's success by how high he climbs but how high he bounces when he hits bottom.

quotes.author: George S. Patton
quotes.quote: A good plan violently executed now is better than a perfect plan executed next week.

quotes.author: George S. Patton
quotes.quote: Never tell people how to do things. Tell them what to do and they will surprise you with their ingenuity.

quotes.author: George S. Patton
quotes.quote: By perseverance, study, and eternal desire, any man can become great.

quotes.author: George S. Patton
quotes.quote: It is only by doing things others have not that one can advance.

quotes.author: George S. Patton
quotes.quote: Moral courage is the most valuable and usually the most absent characteristic in men.

quotes.author: George S. Patton
quotes.quote: Good tactics can save even the worst strategy. Bad tactics will destroy even the best strategy.

quotes.author: George S. Patton
quotes.quote: Lead me, follow me, or get out of my way.

quotes.author: George S. Patton
quotes.quote: Courage is fear holding on a minute longer.

quotes.author: George S. Patton
quotes.quote: An army is a team. It lives, sleeps, eats, and fights as a team.

quotes.author: George S. Patton
quotes.quote: I don't fear failure, I only fear the slowing up of the engine inside of me which is pounding, saying, 'keep going, someone must be on top, why not you?'

quotes.author: H. G. Wells
quotes.quote: To get maximum attention, it's hard to beat a good, big mistake.

quotes.author: H. G. Wells
quotes.quote: Human history is in essence a history of ideas.

quotes.author: H. G. Wells
quotes.quote: Without the idea of progress life is a corrupting mash.

quotes.author: H. G. Wells
quotes.quote: Socialism... ceased to be a creative movement and it become an outlet of passionate expression for the inferiority complex of the disinherited.

quotes.author: H. G. Wells
quotes.quote: Moral indignation is jealousy with a halo.

quotes.author: Homer
quotes.quote: In youth and beauty wisdom is but rare!

quotes.author: Homer
quotes.quote: Toil is the lot of all, and better woe The fate of many.

quotes.author: Homer
quotes.quote: A glorious death is his who for his country falls.

quotes.author: Horace
quotes.quote: To have begun is half the job; be bold and be sensible.

quotes.author: Horace
quotes.quote: Pale Death, with impartial step, knocks at the poor man's cottage and the palaces of kings.

quotes.author: Horace
quotes.quote: Anger is momentary madness, so control your passion or it will control you.

quotes.author: Horace
quotes.quote: If any man seeks for greatness, let him forget greatness, and ask for truth, and he will find both.

quotes.author: Horace
quotes.quote: At the rider's back sits dark Anxiety.

quotes.author: Horace
quotes.quote: He will always be a slave who does not know how to live upon a little.

quotes.author: Horace
quotes.quote: Poets are the first teachers of mankind.

quotes.author: Horace
quotes.quote: Seize the present day, trusting the tomorrow as little as you can.

quotes.author: Horace
quotes.quote: Riches either serve or govern the possessor.

quotes.author: Horace
quotes.quote: A word once let out of the cage cannot be whistled back again.

quotes.author: Horace
quotes.quote: He who has begun has half done. Dare to be wise; begin.

quotes.author: Horace
quotes.quote: Happy the man who, far away from business, like the race of men of old, tills his ancestral fields with his own oxen, unbound by any interest to pay.

quotes.author: Horace
quotes.quote: You may drive out nature with a pitchfork, yet she'll be constantly running back.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: Nothing endures but change.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: The road uphill and the road downhill are one and the same.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: All is flux, nothing stands still.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: The sun is new each day.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: A man's character is his fate.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: Big results require big ambitions.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: Bigotry is the sacred disease.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: Change alone is unchanging.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: Character is destiny.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: Corpses are more fit to be thrown out than is dung.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: Couples are wholes and not wholes, what agrees disagrees, the concordant is discordant. From all things one and from one all things.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: Deliberate violence is more to be quenched than a fire.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: Even sleepers are workers and collaborators in what goes on in the Universe.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: Eyes and ears are poor witnesses to people if they have uncultured souls.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: God is day and night, winter and summer, war and peace, surfeit and hunger.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: Good character is not formed in a week or a month. It is created little by little, day by day. Protracted and patient effort is needed to develop good character.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: Hide our ignorance as we will, an evening of wine soon reveals it.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: I am what libraries and librarians have made me, with little assistance from a professor of Greek and poets.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: If you do not expect the unexpected you will not find it, for it is not to be reached by search or trail.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: It is hard to contend against one's heart's desire; for whatever it wishes to have it buys at the cost of soul.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: Justice will overtake fabricators of lies and false witnesses.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: Man is most nearly himself when he achieves the seriousness of a child at play.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: Men who wish to know about the world must learn about it in its particular details.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: Much learning does not teach understanding.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: No man ever steps in the same river twice, for it's not the same river and he's not the same man.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: No one that encounters prosperity does not also encounter danger.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: Opposition brings concord. Out of discord comes the fairest harmony.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: Our envy always lasts longer than the happiness of those we envy.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: The best people renounce all for one goal, the eternal fame of mortals; but most people stuff themselves like cattle.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: The chain of wedlock is so heavy that it takes two to carry it - and sometimes three.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: The eyes are more exact witnesses than the ears.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: There is nothing permanent except change.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: To God everything is beautiful, good, and just; humans, however, think some things are unjust and others just.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: To do the same thing over and over again is not only boredom: it is to be controlled by rather than to control what you do.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: You could not step twice into the same river; for other waters are ever flowing on to you.

quotes.author: Heraclitus
quotes.quote: Time is a game played beautifully by children.

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: Prudence reproaches; conscience accuses.

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: Two things fill my mind with ever-increasing wonder and awe: the starry heavens above me and the moral law within me.

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: Morality is not properly the doctrine of how we may make ourselves happy, but how we may make ourselves worthy of happiness.

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: Act only on that principle whereby you can at the same time want that it should become a universal law.

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: A categorical imperative would be one which represented an action as objectively necessary in itself, without reference to any other purpose.

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: All the interests of my reason, speculative as well as practical, combine in the three following questions: 1. What can I know? 2. What ought I to do? 3. What may I hope?

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: Always recognize that human individuals are ends, and do not use them as means to your end.

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: But although all our knowledge begins with experience, it does not follow that it arises from experience.

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: By a lie, a man... annihilates his dignity as a man.

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: Even philosophers will praise war as ennobling mankind, forgetting the Greek who said: 'War is bad in that it begets more evil than it kills.'

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: Experience without theory is blind, but theory without experience is mere intellectual play.

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: Happiness is not an ideal of reason, but of imagination.

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: He who is cruel to animals becomes hard also in his dealings with men. We can judge the heart of a man by his treatment of animals.

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: I had therefore to remove knowledge, in order to make room for belief.

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: If man makes himself a worm he must not complain when he is trodden on.

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: Immaturity is the incapacity to use one's intelligence without the guidance of another.

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: In law a man is guilty when he violates the rights of others. In ethics he is guilty if he only thinks of doing so.

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: Ingratitude is the essence of vileness.

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: Intuition and concepts constitute... the elements of all our knowledge, so that neither concepts without an intuition in some way corresponding to them, nor intuition without concepts, can yield knowledge.

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: It is not God's will merely that we should be happy, but that we should make ourselves happy.

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: It is not necessary that whilst I live I live happily; but it is necessary that so long as I live I should live honourably.

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: Live your life as though your every act were to become a universal law.

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: Metaphysics is a dark ocean without shores or lighthouse, strewn with many a philosophic wreck.

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: Nothing is divine but what is agreeable to reason.

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: Out of timber so crooked as that from which man is made nothing entirely straight can be carved.

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: Religion is the recognition of all our duties as divine commands.

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: Seek not the favor of the multitude; it is seldom got by honest and lawful means. But seek the testimony of few; and number not voices, but weigh them.

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: So act that your principle of action might safely be made a law for the whole world.

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: The only objects of practical reason are therefore those of good and evil. For by the former is meant an object necessarily desired according to a principle of reason; by the latter one necessarily shunned, also according to a principle of reason.

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: Thoughts without content are empty, intuitions without concepts are blind.

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: To be is to do.

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: What can I know? What ought I to do? What can I hope?

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: The sum total of all possible knowledge of God is not possible for a human being, not even through a true revelation. But it is one of the worthiest inquiries to see how far our reason can go in the knowledge of God.

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: Nothing in the world — indeed nothing even beyond the world — can possibly be conceived which could be called good without qualification except a good will.

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: Dare to know! Have the courage to use your own reason!\nThis is the motto of the Enlightenment.

quotes.author: Immanuel Kant
quotes.quote: Out of the crooked timber of humanity no straight thing can ever be made.

quotes.author: J. K. Rowling
quotes.quote: The best of us must sometimes eat our words.

quotes.author: John D. Rockefeller
quotes.quote: If you want to succeed you should strike out on new paths, rather than travel the worn paths of accepted success.

quotes.author: John D. Rockefeller
quotes.quote: I do not think there is any other quality so essential to success of any kind as the quality of perseverance. It overcomes almost everything, even nature.

quotes.author: John D. Rockefeller
quotes.quote: I believe in the dignity of labour, whether with head or hand; that the world owes every man opportunity to make a living.

quotes.author: John D. Rockefeller
quotes.quote: Don't be afraid to give up the good to go for the great.

quotes.author: John F. Kennedy
quotes.quote: A man may die, nations may rise and fall, but an idea lives on. Ideas have endurance without death.

quotes.author: John F. Kennedy
quotes.quote: Too often we enjoy the comfort of opinion without the discomfort of thought.

quotes.author: John F. Kennedy
quotes.quote: Ask not what your country can do for you; ask what you can do for your country.

quotes.author: John F. Kennedy
quotes.quote: We must use time as a tool, not as a couch.

quotes.author: John F. Kennedy

quotes.quote: In free society art is not a weapon ... Artists are not engineers of the soul.

quotes.author: John F. Kennedy

quotes.author: Julius Caesar

quotes.author: Julius Caesar
quotes.quote: I came, I saw, I conquered.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Difficulties increase the nearer we approach the goal.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: The important thing in life is to have a great aim, and the determination to attain it.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Nine requisites for contented living: Health enough to make work a pleasure. Wealth enough to support your needs. Strength to battle with difficulties and overcome them. Grace enough to confess your sins and forsake them. Patience enough to toil until some good is accomplished. Charity enough to see some good in your neighbour. Love enough to move you to be useful to others. Faith enough to make real the things of God. Hope enough to remove all anxious fears concerning the future.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Whatever you can do, or dream you can do, begin it. Boldness has genius, power, and magic in it.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: As soon as you trust yourself, you will know how to live.

quotes.quote: Take care of your body with steadfast fidelity. The soul must see through these eyes alone, and if they are dim, the whole world is clouded.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: What matters to an active man is to do the right thing; whether the right thing comes to pass should not bother him.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: To grow older is a new venture in itself.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: To a new truth there is nothing more harmful than old error.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: In all things it is better to hope than to despair.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: The first and last thing required of genius is the love of truth.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: The world can not do without great men, but great men are troublesome to the world.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: There is nothing more frightening than active ignorance.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: One man's word is no man's word; we should quietly hear both sides.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: With knowledge doubt increases.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: After fifteen minutes nobody looks at a rainbow.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Riches amassed in haste will diminish, but those collected by little and little will multiply.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: No one knows what he is doing while he acts right; but of what is wrong we are always conscious.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: We can offer up much in the large, but to make sacrifices in little things is what we are seldom equal to.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Science and art belong to the whole world, and before them, vanish the barriers of nationality.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Self – knowledge is best learned not by contemplation, but actions. Strive to do your duty, and you will soon discover of what stuff you are made.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: It is equally a mistake to hold one's self too high or to rate one's self too cheap.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Our senses don't deceive us, our judgement does.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: The most original authors are not so because they advance what is new, but because they put what they have to say as if it had never been said before.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Treat people as if they were what they should be, and you help them become what they are capable of becoming.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: To think is easy. To act is difficult. To act as one thinks is the most difficult of all.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Nothing is worth more than this day.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Fools and the wise are equally harmless. It is the half-fools and the half-wise that are dangerous.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: As we are constituted by nature, there is not a fault that could not turn into a virtue, not a virtue that could not turn into a fault.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Nature goes her way, and all that to us seems an exception is really according to order.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: One should, every day at least, hear a little song, read a good poem, see a fine picture, and, if possible, speak a few reasonable words.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: A clever man commits no minor blunders.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: A correct answer is like an affectionate kiss.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: A creation of importance can only be produced when its author isolates himself, it is a child of solitude.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: A man's manners are a mirror in which he shows his portrait.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: A noble person attracts noble people, and knows how to hold on to them.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: A person hears only what they understand.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: A person places themselves on a level with the ones they praise.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: All intelligent thoughts have already been thought; what is necessary is only to try to think them again.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: All the knowledge I possess everyone else can acquire, but my heart is all my own.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: All theory, dear friend, is gray, but the golden tree of life springs ever green.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: All things are only transitory.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: An unused life is an early death.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Be above it! Make the world serve your purpose, but do not serve it.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Be generous with kindly words, especially about those who are absent.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Beauty is a manifestation of secret natural laws, which otherwise would have been hidden from us forever.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Beauty is everywhere a welcome guest.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Behaviour is the mirror in which everyone shows their image.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Being brilliant is no great feat if you respect nothing.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Certain defects are necessary for the existence of individuality.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Character, in great and little things, means carrying through what you feel able to do.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Common sense is the genius of humanity.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Daring ideas are like chessmen moved forward; they may be beaten, but they may start a winning game.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Death is a commingling of eternity with time; in the death of a good man, eternity is seen looking through time.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Deeply earnest and thoughtful people stand on shaky footing with the public.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Destiny grants us our wishes, but in its own way, in order to give us something beyond our wishes.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Divide and rule, the politician cries; unite and lead, is watchword of the wise.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Do not give in too much to feelings. A overly sensitive heart is an unhappy possession on this shaky earth.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Doubt grows with knowledge.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Dream no small dreams for they have no power to move the hearts of men.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Every author in some way portrays himself in his works, even if it be against his will.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Every person above the ordinary has a certain mission that they are called to fulfill.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Every spoken word arouses our self-will.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Every step of life shows much caution is required.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Everybody wants to be somebody; nobody wants to grow.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Everything in the world may be endured except continual prosperity.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Few people have the imagination for reality.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: For a man to achieve all that is demanded of him he must regard himself as greater than he is.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Fresh activity is the only means of overcoming adversity.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Girls we love for what they are; young men for what they promise to be.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Go to foreign countries and you will get to know the good things one possesses at home.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Great thoughts and a pure heart, that is what we should ask from God.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Happiness is a ball after which we run wherever it rolls, and we push it with our feet when it stops.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Hatred is active, and envy passive dislike; there is but one step from envy to hate.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: Hatred is something peculiar. You will always find it strongest and most violent where there is the lowest degree of culture.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: He is dead in this world who has no belief in another.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: He is happiest, be he king or peasant, who finds peace in his home.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: He only earns his freedom and his life Who takes them every day by storm.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
quotes.quote: He who does not think much of himself is much more esteemed than he imagines.

quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
