quotes.author: Leo Tolstoy
quotes.quote: Art is not a handicraft; it is the transmission of feeling the artist has experienced.

quotes.author: Leonardo da Vinci
quotes.quote: Man has great power of speech, but the greater part thereof is empty and deceitful. The animals have little, but that little is useful and true; and better is a small and certain thing than a great falsehood.

quotes.author: Leonardo Da Vinci
quotes.quote: When you put your hand in a flowing stream, you touch the last that has gone before and the first of what is still to come.

quotes.author: Leonardo Da Vinci
quotes.quote: As a well-spent day brings happy sleep, So a life well used brings happy death.

quotes.author: Leonardo da Vinci
quotes.quote: You can never have a greater or a lesser dominion than that over yourself.

quotes.author: Leonardo da Vinci
quotes.quote: Iron rusts from disuse, stagnant water loses its purity and in cold weather becomes frozen; so does inaction sap the vigors of the mind.

quotes.author: Leonardo da Vinci
quotes.quote: Anyone who in discussion quotes authority uses his memory rather than his intellect.

quotes.author: Leonardo da Vinci
quotes.quote: If the painter wishes to see beauties that charm him, it lies in his power to create them, and if he wishes to see monstrosities that are frightful, ridiculous, or truly pitiable, he is lord and God thereof.

quotes.author: Leonardo da Vinci
quotes.quote: Human subtlety ... will never devise an invention more beautiful, more simple or more direct than does nature, because in her inventions nothing is lacking, and nothing is superfluous.

quotes.author: Leonardo da Vinci
quotes.quote: The idea or the faculty of imagination serves as both rudder and bridle to the senses, inasmuch as the thing imagined moves the sense.

quotes.author: Leonardo da Vinci
quotes.quote: That painter who has no doubts will achieve little.

quotes.author: Leonardo da Vinci
quotes.quote: Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication.

quotes.author: Leonardo da Vinci
quotes.quote: Obstacles cannot crush me. Every obstacle yields to stern resolve. He who is fixed to a star does not change his mind.

quotes.author: Leonardo da Vinci
quotes.quote: Art is the Queen of all sciences, communicating knowledge to all the generations of the world.

quotes.author: Linus Torvalds
quotes.quote: Most good programmers do programming not because they expect to get paid or get adulation by the public, but because it is fun to program.

quotes.author: Lord Halifax
quotes.quote: We think our children a part of ourselves, though as they grow they might very well underrate us.

quotes.author: Lord Halifax
quotes.quote: Anger raises invention, but it overheats the oven.

quotes.author: Lord Halifax
quotes.quote: Hope is generally a wrong guide, though it is very good company by the way.

quotes.author: Lord Halifax
quotes.quote: When the people contend for their liberty, they seldom get anything by their victory but new masters.

quotes.author: Lord Halifax
quotes.quote: True Merit, like a river, the deeper it is, the less noise it makes.

quotes.author: Lord Halifax
quotes.quote: They who are of opinion that money will do everything may very well be suspected to do everything for money.

quotes.author: Lord Halifax
quotes.quote: A man who is master of patience is master of everything else.

quotes.author: Lord Halifax
quotes.quote: Nothing has an uglier look to us than reason, when it is not on our side.

quotes.author: Michelangelo
quotes.quote: Trifles make perfection, and perfection is no trifle.

quotes.author: Michelangelo
quotes.quote: I saw the angel in the marble and carved until I set him free.

quotes.author: Michelangelo
quotes.quote: A beautiful thing never gives so much pain as does failing to hear and see it.

quotes.author: Michelangelo
quotes.quote: I am no artist—please come and help me.

quotes.author: Michelangelo
quotes.quote: Good painting is the kind that looks like sculpture.

quotes.author: Michelangelo
quotes.quote: A great sculpture can roll down a hill without breaking.

quotes.author: Michelangelo
quotes.quote: The stone unhewn and cold Becomes a living mold. The more the marble wastes, The more the statue grows.

quotes.author: Michelangelo
quotes.quote: The true work of art is but a shadow of the divine perfection.

quotes.author: Michelangelo
quotes.quote: My soul can find no staircase to heaven unless it be through Earth's loveliness.

quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte
quotes.quote: Impossible is a word to be found only in the dictionary of fools.

quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte
quotes.quote: A leader is a dealer in hope.

quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte
quotes.quote: There are two levers for moving men: interest and fear.

quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte
quotes.quote: Ability is of little account without opportunity.

quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte
quotes.quote: The one permanent emotion of the inferior man is fear.

quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte
quotes.quote: Where flowers degenerate man cannot live.

quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte
quotes.quote: What is history but a fable agreed upon!

quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte
quotes.quote: The human race is governed by its imagination.

quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte
quotes.quote: 'Impossible'! That is not good French.

quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte
quotes.quote: The future destiny of the child is always the work of the mother.

quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte
quotes.quote: It requires more courage to suffer than to die.

quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte
quotes.quote: A statesman's heart should always be in his head.

quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte
quotes.quote: Alexander, Caesar, Charlemagne, and myself founded empires; but what foundation did we rest the creations of our genius? Upon force. Jesus Christ founded an empire upon love; and at this hour millions of men would die for Him.

quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte
quotes.quote: As for me, to love you alone, to make you happy, to do nothing which would contradict your wishes, this is my destiny and the meaning of my life.

quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte
quotes.quote: Chance is the providence of adventurers.

quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte
quotes.quote: Character is victory organized.

quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte
quotes.quote: Courage is like love; it must have hope to nourish it.

quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte
quotes.quote: Do you wish to find out the really sublime? Repeat the Lord's Prayer.

quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte
quotes.quote: Great ambition is the passion of a great character. Those endowed with it may perform very good or very bad acts. All depends on the principals which direct them.

quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte
quotes.quote: I tell you Wellington is a bad general, the English are bad soldiers; we will settle this matter by lunch time.

quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte
quotes.quote: Public opinion is the thermometer a monarch should constantly consult.

quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte
quotes.quote: The conscience is the sacred haven of the liberty of man.

quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte
quotes.quote: The only one who is wiser than anyone is everyone.

quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte
quotes.quote: The only victory over love is flight.

quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte
quotes.quote: The people to fear are not those who disagree with you, but those who disagree with you and are too cowardly to let you know.

quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte
quotes.quote: The torment of precautions often exceeds the dangers to be avoided. It is sometimes better to abandon one's self to destiny.

quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte
quotes.quote: When soldiers have been baptized in the fire of a battle-field, they have all one rank in my eyes.

quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte
quotes.quote: You must not fight too often with one enemy, or you will teach him all your art of war.

quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte
quotes.quote: It is only a step from the sublime to the ridiculous.

quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte
quotes.quote: It [the Channel] is a mere ditch, and will be crossed as soon as someone has the courage to attempt it.

quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte
quotes.quote: History is the version of past events that people have decided to agree upon.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: There is nothing more difficult to take in hand, more perilous to conduct, or more uncertain in its success, than to take the lead in the introduction of a new order of things.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: The reformer has enemies in all who profit by the old order, and only lukewarm defenders in those who would profit by the new order.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: The lion cannot protect himself from traps, and the fox cannot defend himself from wolves. One must therefore be a fox to recognise traps, and a lion to frighten wolves.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: A prince never lacks legitimate reasons to break his promise.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: A return to first principles in a republic is sometimes caused by the simple virtues of one man. His good example has such an influence that the good men strive to imitate him, and the wicked are ashamed to lead a life so contrary to his example.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: A son can bear with equanimity the loss of his father, but the loss of his inheritance may drive him to despair.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: A wise ruler ought never to keep faith when by doing so it would be against his interests.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: Before all else, be armed.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: Benefits should be conferred gradually; and in that way they will taste better.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: Entrepreneurs are simply those who understand that there is little difference between obstacle and opportunity and are able to turn both to their advantage.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: For among other evils caused by being disarmed, it renders you contemptible; which is one of those disgraceful things which a prince must guard against.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: God is not willing to do everything, and thus take away our free will and that share of glory which belongs to us.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: Hatred is gained as much by good works as by evil.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: He who wishes to be obeyed must know how to command.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: I'm not interested in preserving the status quo; I want to overthrow it.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: If an injury has to be done to a man it should be so severe that his vengeance need not be feared.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: It is double pleasure to deceive the deceiver.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: It is necessary for him who lays out a state and arranges laws for it to presuppose that all men are evil and that they are always going to act according to the wickedness of their spirits whenever they have free scope.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: It is not titles that honor men, but men that honor titles.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: Men are so simple and so much inclined to obey immediate needs that a deceiver will never lack victims for his deceptions.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: Men are so simple and yield so readily to the desires of the moment that he who will trick will always find another who will suffer to be tricked.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: Men rise from one ambition to another: first, they seek to secure themselves against attack, and then they attack others.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: Men shrink less from offending one who inspires love than one who inspires fear.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: Never was anything great achieved without danger.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: Of mankind we may say in general they are fickle, hypocritical, and greedy of gain.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: One change always leaves the way open for the establishment of others.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: One who deceives will always find those who allow themselves to be deceived.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: Politics have no relation to morals.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: Princes and governments are far more dangerous than other elements within society.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: Severities should be dealt out all at once, so that their suddenness may give less offense; benefits ought to be handed ought drop by drop, so that they may be relished the more.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: Tardiness often robs us opportunity, and the dispatch of our forces.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: The distinction between children and adults, while probably useful for some purposes, is at bottom a specious one, I feel. There are only individual egos, crazy for love.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: The fact is that a man who wants to act virtuously in every way necessarily comes to grief among so many who are not virtuous.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: The first method for estimating the intelligence of a ruler is to look at the men he has around him.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: The main foundations of every state, new states as well as ancient or composite ones, are good laws and good arms you cannot have good laws without good arms, and where there are good arms, good laws inevitably follow.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: The new ruler must determine all the injuries that he will need to inflict. He must inflict them once and for all.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: The one who adapts his policy to the times prospers, and likewise that the one whose policy clashes with the demands of the times does not.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: The promise given was a necessity of the past: the word broken is a necessity of the present.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: The wise man does at once what the fool does finally.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: The wish to acquire more is admittedly a very natural and common thing; and when men succeed in this they are always praised rather than condemned. But when they lack the ability to do so and yet want to acquire more at all costs, they deserve condemnation for their mistakes.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: There are three kinds of intelligence: one kind understands things for itself, the other appreciates what others can understand, the third understands neither for itself nor through others. This first kind is excellent, the second good, and the third kind useless.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: There is no avoiding war; it can only be postponed to the advantage of others.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: There is no surer sign of decay in a country than to see the rites of religion held in contempt.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: To understand the nature of the people one must be a prince, and to understand the nature of the prince, one must be of the people.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: War is just when it is necessary; arms are permissible when there is no hope except in arms.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: War should be the only study of a prince. He should consider peace only as a breathing-time, which gives him leisure to contrive, and furnishes as ability to execute, military plans.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: We cannot attribute to fortune or virtue that which is achieved without either.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: When you disarm the people, you commence to offend them and show that you distrust them either through cowardice or lack of confidence, and both of these opinions generate hatred.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: Where the willingness is great, the difficulties cannot be great.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: Whoever conquers a free town and does not demolish it commits a great error and may expect to be ruined himself.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: Whosoever desires constant success must change his conduct with the times.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: The more sand had escaped from the hourglass of our life, the clearer we should see through it.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: Therefore it is unnecessary for a prince to have all the good qualities I have enumerated, but it is very necessary to appear to have them. And I shall dare to say this also, that to have them and always to observe them is injurious, and that to appear to have them is useful; to appear merciful, faithful, humane, religious, upright, and to be so, but with a mind so framed that should you require not to be so, you may be able and know how to change to the opposite.

quotes.author: Niccolò Machiavelli
quotes.quote: Wars begin when you will, but they do not end when you please.

quotes.author: Nikola Tesla
quotes.quote: Be alone, that is the secret of invention; be alone, that is when ideas are born.

quotes.author: Nikola Tesla
quotes.quote: I am credited with being one of the hardest workers and perhaps I am, if thought is the equivalent of labour, for I have devoted to it almost all of my waking hours. But if work is interpreted to be a definite performance in a specified time according to a rigid rule, then I may be the worst of idlers.

quotes.author: Nikola Tesla
quotes.quote: I do not think there is any thrill that can go through the human heart like that felt by the inventor as he sees some creation of the brain unfolding to success... Such emotions make a man forget food, sleep, friends, love, everything.

quotes.author: Nikola Tesla
quotes.quote: I do not think you can name many great inventions that have been made by married men.

quotes.author: Nikola Tesla
quotes.quote: I don't care that they stole my idea... I care that they don't have any of their own.

quotes.author: Nikola Tesla
quotes.quote: If your hate could be turned into electricity, it would light up the whole world.

quotes.author: Nikola Tesla
quotes.quote: If you want to find the secrets of the universe, think in terms of energy, frequency and vibration.

quotes.author: Nikola Tesla
quotes.quote: Invention is the most important product of man's creative brain. The ultimate purpose is the complete mastery of mind over the material world, the harnessing of human nature to human needs.

quotes.author: Nikola Tesla
quotes.quote: Life is and will ever remain an equation incapable of solution, but it contains certain known factors.

quotes.author: Nikola Tesla
quotes.quote: My brain is only a receiver, in the Universe there is a core from which we obtain knowledge, strength and inspiration. I have not penetrated into the secrets of this core, but I know that it exists.

quotes.author: Nikola Tesla
quotes.quote: One must be sane to think clearly, but one can think deeply and be quite insane.

quotes.author: Nikola Tesla
quotes.quote: The individual is ephemeral, races and nations come and pass away, but man remains.

quotes.author: Nikola Tesla
quotes.quote: The present is theirs; the future, for which I really worked, is mine.

quotes.author: Nikola Tesla
quotes.quote: Today's scientists have substituted mathematics for experiments, and they wander off through equation after equation, and eventually build a structure which has no relation to reality.

quotes.author: Nikola Tesla
quotes.quote: We crave for new sensations but soon become indifferent to them. The wonders of yesterday are today common occurrences.

quotes.author: Nikola Tesla
quotes.quote: What one man calls God, another calls the laws of physics.

quotes.author: Nikola Tesla
quotes.quote: What we now want is closer contact and better understanding between individuals and communities all over the earth, and the elimination of egoism and pride which is always prone to plunge the world into primeval barbarism and strife... Peace can only come as a natural consequence of universal enlightenment...

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: To speak frankly, I am not in favour of long engagements. They give people the opportunity of finding out each other's character before marriage, which I think is never advisable.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: When people are tied together for life they too often regard manners as a mere superfluity, and courtesy as a thing of no moment; but where the bond can be easily broken, its very fragility makes its strength, and reminds the husband that he should always try to please, and the wife that she should never cease to be charming.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: Life is terribly deficient in form. Its catastrophes happen in the wrong way and to the wrong people.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: Men always want to be a woman's first love. That is their clumsy vanity. We women have a more subtle instinct about things. What we like is to be a man's last romance.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: Yes: I am a dreamer. For a dreamer is one who can only find his way by moonlight, and his punishment is that he sees the dawn before the rest of the world.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: If one cannot enjoy reading a book over and over again, there is no use in reading it at all.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: You can never be overdressed or overeducated.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: Most people are other people. Their thoughts are someone else's opinions, their lives a mimicry, their passions a quotation.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: Anyone who lives within their means suffers from a lack of imagination.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: I think God, in creating man, somewhat overestimated his ability.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: Man is least himself when he talks in his own person. Give him a mask, and he will tell you the truth.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: Never love anyone who treats you like you're ordinary.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: A man's face is his autobiography. A woman's face is her work of fiction.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: I choose my friends for their good looks, my acquaintances for their good characters, and my enemies for their good intellects.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: We live in an age when unnecessary things are our only necessities.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: When the gods wish to punish us, they answer our prayers.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: My own business always bores me to death; I prefer other people's.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: What is a cynic? A man who knows the price of everything and the value of nothing.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: The critic has to educate the public; the artist has to educate the critic.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: The Americans are certainly hero-worshippers, and always take their heroes from the criminal classes.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: If you pretend to be good, the world takes you very seriously. If you pretend to be bad, it doesn't. Such is the astounding stupidity of optimism.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: If you want to tell people the truth, make them laugh, otherwise they'll kill you.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: The public have an insatiable curiosity to know everything, except what is worth knowing.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: A man can be happy with any woman as long as he does not love her.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: No man is rich enough to buy back his past.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: Nothing can cure the soul but the senses, just as nothing can cure the senses but the soul.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: One should always be in love. That is the reason one should never marry.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: It is always a silly thing to give advice, but to give good advice is fatal.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: Pessimist: One who, when he has the choice of two evils, chooses both.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: There is no necessity to separate the monarch from the mob; all authority is equally bad.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: The moment you think you understand a great work of art, it's dead for you.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: An excellent man; he has no enemies; and none of his friends like him.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: Democracy means simply the bludgeoning of the people by the people for the people.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: No great artist ever sees things as they really are. If he did, he would cease to be an artist.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: Between men and women there is no friendship possible. There is passion, enmity, worship, love, but no friendship.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: To expect the unexpected shows a thoroughly modern intellect.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: Morality is simply the attitude we adopt toward people whom we personally dislike.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: Only the shallow know themselves.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: Anyone can sympathize with the sufferings of a friend, but it requires a very fine nature to sympathize with a friend's success.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: In examinations, the foolish ask questions the wise cannot answer.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: The well bred contradict other people. The wise contradict themselves.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: The basis of action is lack of imagination. It is the last recourse of those who know not how to dream.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: One should never trust a woman who tells one her real age. A woman, who would tell one that, would tell one anything.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: The old believe everything; the middle- aged suspect everything; the young know everything.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: It is only shallow people who do not judge by appearances.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: By persistently remaining single a man converts himself into a permanent public temptation.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: There is no such thing as a moral or an immoral book. Books are well written or badly written. That is all.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: Few parents nowadays pay any regard to what their children say to them. The old fashioned respect for the young is fast dying out.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: It is the confession, not the priest, that gives us absolution.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: To be natural is such a very difficult pose to keep up.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: Conscience and cowardice are really the same thing. Conscience is the trade - name of the firm.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: Let me say to you that to do nothing at all is the most difficult thing in the world, the most difficult, and it most intellectual.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: Education is an admirable thing, but it is well to remember from time to time that nothing that is worth knowing can be taught.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: A man cannot be too careful in the choice of his enemies.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: None of us can stand other people having the same faults as ourselves.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: An acquaintance that begins with a compliment is sure to develop into a real friendship.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: I have nothing to declare except my genius.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: Nothing spoils a romance so much as a sense of humour in the woman.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: One can always recognize women who trust their husbands. They look so thoroughly unhappy.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: Ignorance is like a delicate exotic fruit; touch it and the bloom is gone.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: One can always be kind to people, one cares nothing about.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: The only form of lying that is absolutely beyond reproach is lying for its own sake.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: Literature always anticipates life. It does not copy it, but moulds it to its purpose.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: The difference between literature and journalism is that journalism is unreadable, and literature is not read.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: Men marry because they are tired, women because they are curious: both are disappointed.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: Young people, nowadays, imagine that money is everything, and when they grow older they know it.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: The tragedy of old age is not that one is old, but that one is young.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
quotes.quote: To have become a deepest man is the privilege of those who have suffered.

quotes.author: Oscar Wilde
