quotes.quote: The usual approach of science of constructing a mathematical model cannot answer the questions of why there should be a universe for the model to describe. Why does the universe go to all the bother of existing?

quotes.author: Stephen Hawking
quotes.quote: To confine our attention to terrestrial matters would be to limit the human spirit.

quotes.author: Stephen Hawking
quotes.quote: Equations are more important to me because politics is for the present but an equation is something for eternity.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: According to my assessment, even if you have many more troops than others, how can that help you to victory?

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Act after having made assessments. The one who first knows the measure of far and near wins - this is the rule of armed struggle.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: All men can see these tactics whereby I conquer, but what none can see is the strategy out of which victory is evolved.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: All warfare is based on deception. Hence, when able to attack, we must seem unable; when using our forces, we must seem inactive; when we are near, we must make the enemy believe we are far away; when far away, we must make him believe we are near.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Amid the turmoil and tumult of battle, there may be seeming disorder and yet no real disorder at all.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: An army may be likened to water, for just as flowing water avoids the heights and hastens to the lowlands, so an army avoids strength and strikes weakness.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Apparent confusion is a product of good order; apparent cowardice, of courage; apparent weakness, of strength.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: As water has no constant form, there are in war no constant conditions.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: At first, then, exhibit the coyness of a maiden, until the enemy gives you an opening; afterwards emulate the rapidity of a running hare, and it will be too late for the enemy to oppose you.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Be extremely subtle, even to the point of formlessness. Be extremely mysterious, even to the point of soundlessness. Thereby you can be the director of the opponent's fate.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Bestow rewards without respect to customary practice; publish orders without respect to precedent. Thus you may employ the entire army as you would one man.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Bring war material with you from home, but forage on the enemy... use the conquered foe to augment one's own strength.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Carefully compare the opposing army with your own, so that you may know where strength is superabundant and where it is deficient.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Carefully study the well-being of your men, and do not overtax them. Concentrate your energy and hoard your strength. Keep your army continually on the move, and devise unfathomable plans.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Confront them with annihilation, and they will then survive; plunge them into a deadly situation, and they will then live. When people fall into danger, they are then able to strive for victory.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Do not swallow bait offered by the enemy. Do not interfere with an army that is returning home.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Energy may be likened to the bending of a crossbow; decision, to the releasing of a trigger.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Fighting with a large army under your command is nowise different from fighting with a small one: it is merely a question of instituting signs and signals.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: For the wise man delights in establishing his merit, the brave man likes to show his courage in action, the covetous man is quick at seizing advantages, and the stupid man has no fear of death.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Getting people to fight by letting the force of momentum work is like rolling logs and rocks. Logs and rocks are still when in a secure place, but roll on an incline; they remain stationary if square, they roll if round. Therefore, when people are skillfuly led into battle, the momentum is like that of round rocks rolling down a high mountain -- this is force.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Ground which can be abandoned but is hard to re-occupy is called entangling.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: He who exercises no forethought but makes light of his opponents is sure to be captured by them.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: He who is not sage and wise, humane and just, cannot use secret agent's. And he who is not delicate and subtle cannot get the truth out of them.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: He will win whose army is animated by the same spirit throughout all its ranks.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Hence the saying: If you know the enemy and you know yourself, your victory will not stand in doubt; if you now Heaven and you know Earth, you may make your victory complete.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Hold out baits to entice the enemy. Feign disorder, and crush him.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Hostile armies may face each other for years, striving for the victory which is decided in a single day. This being so, to remain in ignorance of the enemy's condition simply because one grudges the outlay of a hundred ounces of silver in honors and emoluments, is the height of inhumanity.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Humble words and increased preparations are signs that the enemy is about to advance. Violent language and driving forward as if to the attack are signs that he will retreat.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: If fighting is sure to result in victory, then you must fight, even though the ruler forbid it; if fighting will not result in victory, then you must not fight even at the ruler's bidding.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: If I am able to determine the enemy's dispositions while at the same time I conceal my own, then I can concentrate and he must divide.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: If it is to your advantage, make a forward move; if not, stay where you are.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: If not in the interests of the state, do not act. If you cannot succeed, do not use troops. If you are not in danger, do not fight.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: If our soldiers are not overburdened with money, it is not because they have a distaste for riches; if their lives are not unduly long, it is not because they are disinclined to longevity.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: If soldiers are punished before they have grown attached to you, they will not prove submissive; and, unless submissive, then will be practically useless. If, when the soldiers have become attached to you, punishments are not enforced, they will still be unless.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: If those who are sent to draw water begin by drinking themselves, the army is suffering from thirst.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: If we wish to fight, the enemy can be forced to an engagement even though he be sheltered behind a high rampart and a deep ditch. All we need do is attack some other place that he will be obliged to relieve.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: If words of command are not clear and distinct, if orders are not thoroughly understood, the general is to blame. But if his orders are clear, and the soldiers nevertheless disobey, then it is the fault of their officers.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: If you are situated at a great distance from the enemy, and the strength of the two armies is equal, it is not easy to provoke a battle, and fighting will be to your disadvantage.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: If you fight with all your might, there is a chance of life; where as death is certain if you cling to your corner.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: If you know yourself but not the enemy, for every victory gained you will also suffer a defeat.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: If your opponent is of choleric temper, seek to irritate him. Pretend to be weak, that he may grow arrogant.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: If, however, you are indulgent, but unable to make your authority felt; kind-hearted, but unable to enforce your commands; and incapable, moreover, of quelling disorder: then your soldiers must be likened to spoilt children; they are useless for any practical purpose.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: In all fighting, the direct method may be used for joining battle, but indirect methods will be needed in order to secure victory. In battle, there are not more than two methods of attack: the direct and the indirect; yet these two in combination give rise to an endless series of maneuvers.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: In making tactical dispositions, the highest pitch you can attain is to conceal them.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: In peace prepare for war, in war prepare for peace. The art of war is of vital importance to the state. It is matter of life and death, a road either to safety or to ruin. Hence under no circumstances can it be neglected.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: In the midst of difficulties we are always ready to seize an advantage, we may extricate ourselves from misfortune.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: In the practical art of war, the best thing of all is to take the enemy's country whole and intact; to shatter and destroy it is not so good.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: In warfare, first lay plans which will ensure victory, and then lead your army to battle; if you will not begin with stratagem but rely on brute strength alone, victory will no longer be assured.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: In warfare, there are no constant conditions. He who can modify his tactics in relation to his opponent will succeed and win.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: It is a doctrine of war not to assume the enemy will not come, but rather to rely on one's readiness to meet him; not to presume that he will not attack, but rather to make one's self invincible.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: It is only one who is thoroughly acquainted with the evils of war that can thoroughly understand the profitable way of carrying it on.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: It is only the enlightened ruler and the wise general who will use the highest intelligence of the army for the purposes of spying, and thereby they achieve great results.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: It is the business of a general to be quiet and thus ensure secrecy; upright and just, and thus maintain order.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: It is the rule in war, if our forces are ten to the enemy's one, to surround him; if five to one, to attack him; if twice as numerous, to divide our army into two.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: It is through the dispositions of an army that its condition may be discovered. Conceal your dispositions, and your condition will remain secret, which leads to victory,; show your dispositions, and your condition will become patent, which leads to defeat.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Know the enemy, know yourself; your victory will never be endangered. Know the ground, know the weather; your victory will then be total.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Knowledge of the enemy's dispositions can only be obtained from other men.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Like the sun and moon, they end but to begin anew; like the four seasons, they pass away to return once more.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Making no mistakes is what establishes the certainty of victory, for it means conquering an enemy that is already defeated.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Maneuvering with an army is advantageous; with an undisciplined multitude, most dangerous.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Move not unless you see an advantage; use not your troops unless there is something to be gained; fight not unless the position is critical.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Now a soldier's spirit is keenest in the morning; by noonday it has begun to flag; and in the evening, his mind is only on returning to camp.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Now this foreknowledge cannot be elicited from spirits; it cannot be obtained inductively from experience, nor by any deductive calculation.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: One defends when his strength is inadequate, he attacks when it is abundant.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: One mark of a great soldier is that he fight on his own terms or fights not at all.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: One who speaks deferentially but increases his preparations will advance. One who speaks belligerently and advances hastily will retreat.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: One whose troops repeatedly congregate in small groups here and there, whispering together, has lost the masses. One who frequently grants rewards is in deep distress. One who frequently imposes punishments is in great difficulty. One who is at first excessively brutal and then fears the masses is the pinnacle of stupidity.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Plan for what is difficult while it is easy, do what is great while it is small. The difficult things in this world must be done while they are easy, the greatest things in the world must be done while they are still small. For this reason sages never do what is great, and this is why they achieve greatness.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Prohibit the taking of omens, and do away with superstitious doubts. Then, until death itself comes, no calamity need be feared.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Rapidity is the essence of war: take advantage of the enemy's unreadiness, make your way by unexpected routes, and attack unguarded spots.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Regard your soldiers as your children, and they will follow you into the deepest valleys; look upon them as your own beloved sons, and they will stand by you even unto death.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Rewards for good service should not be deferred a single day.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Set the troops to their tasks without imparting your designs.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Should the enemy strengthen his van, he will weaken his rear; should he strengthen his rear, he will weaken his van; should he strengthen his left, he will weaken his right; should he strengthen his right, he will weaken his left. If he sends reinforcements everywhere, he will everywhere be weak.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: So in war, the way is to avoid what is strong and to strike at what is weak. Water shapes its course according to the nature of the ground over which it flows; the soldier works out his victory in relation to the foe whom he is facing.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: So there are five ways of knowing who will win. Those who know when to fight and when not to fight are victorious. Those who discern when to use many or few troops are victorious. Those whose upper and lower ranks have the same desire are victorious.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Someone unfamiliar with the mountains and forests cannot advance [the team]. One who does not employ local guides cannot gain the advantage.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Spies cannot be usefully employed without a certain intuitive sagacity.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Subjugating the enemy's army without fighting is the true pinnacle of excellence.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Success in warfare is gained by carefully accommodating ourselves to the enemy's purpose.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: The art of giving orders is not to try to rectify the minor blunders and not be swayed by petty doubts.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: The art of war teaches us to rely not on the likelihood of the enemy's not coming, but on our own readiness to receive him; not on the chance of his not attacking, but rather on the fact that we have made our position unassailable.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: The best victory is when the opponent surrenders of its own accord before there are any actual hostilities.... It is best to win without fighting.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: The consummate leader cultivates the moral law, and strictly adheres to method and discipline; thus it is in his power to control success.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: The control of a large force is the same principle as the control of a few men: it is merely a question of dividing up their numbers.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: The difficulty of tactical maneuvering consists in turning the devious into the direct, and misfortune into gain.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: The end and aim of spying in all its five varieties is knowledge of the enemy; and this knowledge can only be derived, in the first instance, from the converted spy. Hence it is essential that the converted spy be treated with the utmost liberality.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: The enemy's spies who have come to spy on us must be sought out, tempted with bribes, led away and comfortably housed. Thus they will become double agents and available for our service. It is through the information brought by the double agent that we are able to acquire and employ local and inward spies. It is owing to his information, again, that we can cause the doomed spy to carry false tidings to the enemy.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: The general that hearkens to my counsel and acts upon it, will conquer: let such a one be retained in command! The general that hearkens not to my counsel nor acts upon it, will suffer defeat: - let such a one be dismissed!

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: The general who wins a battle makes many calculations in his temple ere the battle is fought. The general who loses a battle makes but few calculations beforehand. Thus do many calculations lead to victory, and few calculations to defeat: how much more no calculation at all! It is by attention to this point that I can foresee who is likely to win or lose.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: The leader of armies is the arbiter of the people's fate, the man on whom it depends whether the nation shall be in peace or in peril.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: The natural formation of the country is the soldier's best ally; but a power of estimating the adversary, of controlling the forces of victory, and of shrewdly calculating difficulties, dangers and distances, constitutes the test of a great general.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: The peak efficiency of knowledge and strategy is to make conflict unnecessary.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: The quality of a decision is like the well-timed swoop of a falcon which enables it to strike and destroy its victim.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: The skillful employer of men will employ the wise man, the brave man, the covetous man, and the stupid man.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: The skillful tactician may be likened to the shuai-jan. Now the shuai-jan is a snake that is found in the Ch'ang mountains. Strike at its head, and you will be attacked by its tail; strike at its tail, and you will be attacked by its head; strike at its middle, and you will be attacked by head and tail both.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: The spot where we intend to fight must not be made known; for then the enemy will have to prepare against a possible attack at several different points; and his forces being thus distributed in many directions, the numbers we shall have to face at any given point will be proportionately few.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: There are five dangerous faults which may affect a general: recklessness, which leads to destruction; cowardice, which leads to capture; a hasty temper, which can be provoked by insults; a delicacy of honour, which is sensitive to shame; over-solicitude for his men, which exposes him to worry and trouble.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: There are roads which must not be followed, armies which must not be attacked, towns which must not be besieged, positions which must not be contested, commands of the sovereign which must not be obeyed.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: This does not mean that the enemy is to be allowed to escape. The object is to make him believe that there is a road to safety, and thus prevent his fighting with the courage of despair. After that, you may crush him.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Those who do not know the plans of competitors cannot prepare alliances. Those who do not know the lay of the land cannot maneuver their forces. Those who do not use local guides cannot take advantage of the ground.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Throw your soldiers into positions whence there is no escape, and they will prefer death to flight. If they will face death, there is nothing they may not achieve.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Thus it is that in war the victorious strategist only seeks battle after the victory has been won, whereas he who is destined to defeat first fights and afterwards looks for victory.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Thus the skillful general conducts his army just as though he were leading a single man, willy-nilly, by the hand.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Thus those skilled in war subdue the enemy's army without battle.... They conquer by strategy.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: To capture the enemy's entire army is better than to destroy it; to take intact a regiment, a company, or a squad is better than to destroy them. For to win one hundred victories in one hundred battles is not the supreme of excellence. To subdue the enemy without fighting is the supreme excellence.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: To maintain an army at a distance causes the people to be impoverished.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: To perceive victory when it is known to all is not really skillful... It does not take much strength to lift a hair, it does not take sharp eyes to see the sun and moon, it does not take sharp ears to hear the thunderclap.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: To plan secretly, to move surreptitiously, to foil the enemy's intentions and balk his schemes, so that at last the day may be won without shedding a drop of blood.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Too frequent rewards indicate that the general is at the end of his resources; too frequent punishments that he is in acute distress.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Unhappy is the fate of one who tries to win his battles and succeed in his attacks without cultivating the spirit of enterprise, for the result is waste of time and general stagnation.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Unless you enter the tiger's lair, you cannot get hold of the tiger's cub's.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Victorious warriors win first and then go to war, while defeated warriors go to war first and then seek to win.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: We cannot enter into alliance with neighboring princes until we are acquainted with their designs. We are not fit to lead an army on the march unless we are familiar with the face of the country - its mountains and forests, its pitfalls and precipices, its marshes and swamps. We shall be unable to turn natural advantages to account unless we make use of local guides.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: What enables the wise sovereign and the good general to strike and conquer, and achieve things beyond the reach of ordinary men, is foreknowledge.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: What is of supreme importance in war is to attack the enemy's strategy.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: What the ancients called a clever fighter is one who not only wins, but excels in winning with ease.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: When a general, unable to estimate the enemy's strength, allows an inferior force to engage a larger one, or hurls a weak detachment against a powerful one, and neglects to place picked soldiers in the front rank, the result must be rout.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: When envoys are sent with compliments in their mouths, it is a sign that the enemy wishes for a truce.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: When he utilizes combined energy, his fighting men become as it were like unto rolling logs or stones. For it is the nature of a log or stone to remain motionless on level ground, and to move when on a slope; if four-cornered, to come to a standstill, but if round-shaped to go rolling down.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: When torrential water tosses boulders, it is because of its momentum. When the strike of a hawk breaks the body of its prey, it is because of timing.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: When you do battle, even if you are winning, if you continue for a long time it will dull your forces and blunt you edge...If you keep your armies out in the field for a long time, your supplies will be insufficient. Transportation of provisions itself consumes 20 times the amount transported.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: When you surround an army, leave an outlet free. Do not press a desperate foe too hard.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Who does not know the evils of war cannot appreciate its benefits.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Whoever is first in the field and awaits the coming of the enemy, will be fresh for the fight; whoever is second in the field and has to hasten to battle will arrive exhausted.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: With regard to precipitous heights, if you are beforehand with your adversary, you should occupy the raised and sunny spots, and there wait for him to come up.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: To defeat a strong enemy: deploy forces to defend the strategic points; exercise vigilance in preparation; do not be indolent. Deeply investigate the true situation. Secretly await their laxity. Wait until they leave their stronghold. Then seize what they love.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Engage only when it is in the interests of the state: cease when it is to its detriment. Do not move unless there are definite advantages to be won.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: For to win one hundred victories in one hundred battles is not the acme of skill. To subdue the enemy without fighting is the acme of skill.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: He who is prudent and lies in wait for an enemy who is not, will be victorious.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: He who knows when he can fight and when he cannot, will be victorious.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Hence that general is skillful in attack whose opponent does not know what to defend; and he is skilful in defense whose opponent does not know what to attack.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: If ignorant both of your enemy and yourself, you are certain to be in peril.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: If you are far from the enemy, make him believe you are near.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: If you know the enemy and know yourself you need not fear the results of a hundred battles.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Invincibility lies in the defence; the possibility of victory in the attack.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: It is essential to seek out enemy agents who have come to conduct espionage against you and to bribe them to serve you. Give them instructions and care for them. Thus doubled agents are recruited and used.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Know thy self, know thy enemy. A thousand battles, a thousand victories.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Now the reason the enlightened prince and the wise general conquer the enemy whenever they move and their achievements surpass those of ordinary men is foreknowledge.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Of all those in the army close to the commander none is more intimate than the secret agent; of all rewards none more liberal than those given to secret agents; of all matters none is more confidential than those relating to secret operations.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Opportunities multiply as they are seized.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Pretend inferiority and encourage his arrogance.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Secret operations are essential in war; upon them the army relies to make its every move.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: Strategy without tactics is the slowest route to victory. Tactics without strategy is the noise before defeat.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: The enlightened ruler is heedful, and the good general full of caution.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: The general who advances without coveting fame and retreats without fearing disgrace, whose only thought is to protect his country and do good service for his sovereign, is the jewel of the kingdom.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: The good fighters of old first put themselves beyond the possibility of defeat, and then waited for an opportunity of defeating the enemy.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: There is no instance of a nation benefiting from prolonged warfare.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: To fight and conquer in all our battles is not supreme excellence; supreme excellence consists in breaking the enemy's resistance without fighting.

quotes.author: Sun Tzu
quotes.quote: To see victory only when it is within the ken of the common herd is not the acme of excellence.

quotes.author: Terry Pratchett
quotes.quote: In answer to the question: 'Where do you get your incredible ideas from?': 'There's this warehouse called Ideas R Us.'

quotes.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
quotes.quote: To light a candle is to cast a shadow...

quotes.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
quotes.quote: "Tezyeme," he said, which meant something on the order of "it is happening the way it is supposed to happen.

quotes.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
quotes.quote: Rocks have their dreams, and the earth changes... But when the mind becomes conscious, when the rate of evolution speeds up, then you have to be careful. Careful of the world. You must learn the way. You must learn the skills, the art, the limits. A conscious mind must be part of the whole, intentionally and carefully--as the rock is part of the whole unconsciously. Do you see? Does it mean anything to you?

quotes.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
quotes.quote: You cannot buy the revolution. You cannot make the revolution. You can only be the revolution. It is in your spirit, or it is nowhere.

quotes.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
quotes.quote: Nobody who says, 'I told you so' has ever been, or will ever be, a hero.

quotes.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
quotes.quote: To learn which questions are unanswerable, and not to answer them: this skill is most needful in times of stress and darkness.

quotes.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
quotes.quote: The only thing that makes life possible is permanent, intolerable uncertainty: not knowing what comes next.

quotes.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
quotes.quote: It is very hard for evil to take hold of the unconsenting soul.

quotes.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
quotes.quote: But it is one thing to read about dragons and another to meet them.

quotes.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
quotes.quote: Freedom is a heavy load, a great and strange burden for the spirit to undertake. It is not easy. It is not a gift given, but a choice made, and the choice may be a hard one. The road goes upward towards the light; but the laden traveller may never reach the end of it.

quotes.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
quotes.quote: I am living in a nightmare, from which from time to time I wake in sleep.

quotes.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
quotes.quote: Children know perfectly well that unicorns aren't real, but they also know that books about unicorns, if they are good books, are true books.

quotes.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
quotes.quote: Truth is a matter of the imagination.

quotes.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
quotes.quote: Belief is the wound that knowledge heals.

quotes.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
quotes.quote: When action grows unprofitable, gather information; when information grows unprofitable, sleep.

quotes.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
quotes.quote: A profound love between two people involves, after all, the power and chance of doing profound hurt.

quotes.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
quotes.quote: What is an anarchist? One who, choosing, accepts the responsibility of choice.

quotes.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
quotes.quote: This is. And thou art. There is no safety. There is no end. The word must be heard in silence. There must be darkness to see the stars. The dance is always danced above the hollow place, above the terrible abyss.

quotes.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
quotes.quote: There have been great societies that did not use the wheel, but there have been no societies that did not tell stories.

quotes.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
quotes.quote: If you evade suffering you also evade the chance of joy. Pleasure you may get, or pleasures, but you will not be fulfilled. You will not know what it is to come home.

quotes.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
quotes.quote: You can't crush ideas by suppressing them. You can only crush them by ignoring them. By refusing to think, refusing to change.

quotes.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
quotes.quote: A man does not make his destiny: he accepts it or denies it.

quotes.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
quotes.quote: We live in capitalism. Its power seems inescapable. So did the divine right of kings. Any human power can be resisted and changed by human beings. Resistance and change often begin in art, and very often in our art, the art of words.

quotes.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
quotes.quote: The individual cannot bargain with the State. The State recognizes no coinage but power: and it issues the coins itself.

quotes.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
quotes.quote: To see that your life is a story while you're in the middle of living it may be a help to living it well.

quotes.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
quotes.quote: Gradually the healing took place, seeming as it always does that it wasn't taking place.

quotes.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
quotes.quote: We all have forests on our minds. Forests unexplored, unending. Each one of us gets lost in the forest, every night, alone.

quotes.author: Vincent van Gogh
quotes.quote: The sight of the stars always makes me dream.

quotes.author: Vincent van Gogh
quotes.quote: Great things are not done by impulse, but by a series of small things brought together.

quotes.author: Vincent van Gogh
quotes.quote: I cannot help it that my pictures do not sell. Nevertheless the time will come when people will see that they are worth more than the price of the paint.

quotes.author: Vincent van Gogh
quotes.quote: The heart of man is very much like the sea, it has its storms, it has its tides and in its depths it has its pearls too.

quotes.author: Vincent van Gogh
quotes.quote: An artist needn't be a clergyman or a churchwarden, but he certainly must have a warm heart for his fellow men.

quotes.author: Vincent van Gogh
quotes.quote: I tell you, the more I think, the more I feel that there is nothing more truly artistic than to love people.

quotes.author: Vincent van Gogh
quotes.quote: I put my heart and my soul into my work,and have lost my mind in the process.

quotes.author: Vincent van Gogh
quotes.quote: In spite of everything I shall rise again: I will take up my pencil, which I have forsaken in my great discouragement, and I will go on with my drawing.

quotes.author: Vincent van Gogh
quotes.quote: Even the knowledge of my own fallibility cannot keep me from making mistakes. Only when I fall do I get up again.

quotes.author: Vincent van Gogh
quotes.quote: Just dash something down if you see a blank canvas staring at you with a certain imbecility. You do not know how paralyzing it is, that staring of a blank canvas, which says to the painter: you don't know anything.

quotes.author: Vincent van Gogh
quotes.quote: I've failed again!

quotes.author: Vincent van Gogh
quotes.quote: It is not the language of painters but the language of nature which one should listen to; the feeling for the things themselves, for reality, is more important than the feeling for pictures.

quotes.author: Vincent van Gogh
quotes.quote: I experience a period of frightening clarity in those moments when nature is so beautiful. I am no longer sure of myself, and the paintings appear as in a dream.

quotes.author: Vincent van Gogh
quotes.quote: I want to touch people with my art. I want them to say "he feels deeply; he feels tenderly.

quotes.author: Vincent van Gogh
quotes.quote: As a suffering creature, I cannot do without something greater than I—something that is my life—the power to create.

quotes.author: Virgil
quotes.quote: Fear is the proof of a degenerate mind.

quotes.author: Virgil
quotes.quote: The gates of hell are open night and day; Smooth the decent and easy is the way.

quotes.author: Virgil
quotes.quote: Labour conquers everything.

quotes.author: Virgil
quotes.quote: The only safety for the conquered is to expect no safety.

quotes.author: Virgil
quotes.quote: But meanwhile time flies; it flies never to be regained.

quotes.author: Virgil
quotes.quote: We can't all do everything.

quotes.author: Virgil
quotes.quote: Varium et mutabile semper femina.\nWoman is ever a fickle and changeable thing.

quotes.author: Vladimir Lenin
quotes.quote: There are no morals in politics; there is only expedience. A scoundrel may be of use to us just because he is a scoundrel.

quotes.author: Vladimir Lenin
quotes.quote: Give me just one generation of youth, and I'll transform the whole world.

quotes.author: Vladimir Lenin
quotes.quote: There are decades where nothing happens; and there are weeks where decades happen.

quotes.author: Vladimir Lenin
quotes.quote: The way to crush the bourgeoisie is to grind them between the millstones of taxation and inflation.

quotes.author: Vladimir Lenin
quotes.quote: It is true that liberty is precious; so precious that it must be carefully rationed.

quotes.author: Vladimir Lenin
quotes.quote: Sometimes - history needs a push.

quotes.author: Vladimir Lenin
quotes.quote: The best way to control the opposition is to lead it ourselves.

quotes.author: Vladimir Lenin
quotes.quote: It is more pleasant and useful to go through the 'experience of the revolution' than to write about it.

quotes.author: Vladimir Lenin
quotes.quote: One man with a gun can control 100 without one... Make mass searches and hold executions for found arms.

quotes.author: Vladimir Lenin
quotes.quote: One of the basic conditions for the victory of socialism is the arming of the workers and the disarming of the bourgeoisie (the middle class).

quotes.author: Vladimir Lenin
quotes.quote: Fascism is capitalism in decay.

quotes.author: Vladimir Lenin
quotes.quote: Capitalists are no more capable of self-sacrifice than a man is capable of lifting himself up by his own bootstraps.

quotes.author: Vladimir Lenin
quotes.quote: Crime is a product of social excess.

quotes.author: Vladimir Lenin
quotes.quote: The best way to destroy the capitalist system is to debauch the currency.

quotes.author: Vladimir Lenin
quotes.quote: He who now talks about the "freedom of the press" goes backward, and halts our headlong course towards Socialism.

quotes.author: Vladimir Lenin
quotes.quote: Whenever the cause of the people is entrusted to professors, it is lost.

quotes.author: Vladimir Lenin
quotes.quote: No amount of political freedom will satisfy the hungry masses.

quotes.author: Vladimir Lenin
quotes.quote: The history of all countries shows that the working class exclusively by its own effort is able to develop only trade-union consciousness.

quotes.author: Vladimir Lenin
quotes.quote: In the history of modern socialism this is a phenomenon, that the strife of the various trends within the socialist movement has from national become international.

quotes.author: Vladimir Lenin
quotes.quote: War cannot be abolished unless classes are abolished and Socialism is created.

quotes.author: Vladimir Lenin
quotes.quote: Give me four years to teach the children and the seed I have sown will never be uprooted.

quotes.author: Vladimir Lenin
quotes.quote: If it were necessary to give the briefest possible definition of imperialism, we should have to say that imperialism is the monopoly stage of capitalism.

quotes.author: Vladimir Lenin
quotes.quote: Can a nation be free if it oppresses other nations? It cannot.

quotes.author: Vladimir Lenin
quotes.quote: Give us the child for 8 years and it will be a Bolshevik forever.

quotes.author: Vladimir Lenin
quotes.quote: A revolution is impossible without a revolutionary situation; furthermore, not every revolutionary situation leads to revolution.

quotes.author: Vladimir Lenin
quotes.quote: Communism is Soviet power plus the electrification of the whole country.

quotes.author: Vladimir Lenin
quotes.quote: Politics begin where the masses are, not where there are thousands, but where there are millions, that is where serious politics begin.

quotes.author: Vladimir Lenin
quotes.quote: Capital, created by labour of the worker, oppresses the worker by undermining the small proprietor and creating an army of the unemployed.

quotes.author: Vladimir Lenin
quotes.quote: One step forward, two steps back...It happens in the lives of individuals, and it happens in the history of nations.

quotes.author: Vladimir Lenin
quotes.quote: It is impossible to predict the time and progress of revolution. It is governed by its own more or less mysterious laws. But when it comes, it moves irresistibly.

quotes.author: Vladimir Lenin
quotes.quote: So long as the state exists there is no freedom. When there is freedom there will be no state.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: A circumstance which has always appeared wonderful to me, is that such sublime discoveries should have been made by the sole assistance of a quadrant and a little arithmetic.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: A company of solemn tyrants is impervious to all seductions.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: A minister of state is excusable for the harm he does when the helm of government has forced his hand in a storm; but in the calm he is guilty of all the good he does not do.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: A people that sells its own children is more condemnable than the buyer; this commerce demonstrates our superiority; he who gives himself a master was born to have one.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: A prince who writes against flattery is as singular as a pope who writes against infallibility.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: A republic is not founded on virtue, but on the ambition of its citizens.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: A single part of physics occupies the lives of many men, and often leaves them dying in uncertainty.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: All certainty which does not consist in mathematical demonstration is nothing more than the highest probability; there is no other historical certainty.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: All joys do not cause laughter; great pleasures are serious: pleasures of love do not make us laugh.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: All men are by nature free; you have therefore an undoubted liberty to depart whenever you please, but will have many and great difficulties to encounter in passing the frontiers.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: All men would then be necessarily equal, if they were without needs. It is the poverty connected with our species which subordinates one man to another. It is not inequality which is the real misfortune, it is dependence.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: All philosophical sects have run aground on the reef of moral and physical ill. It only remains for us to confess that God, having acted for the best, had not been able to do better.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: All pleasantry should be short; and it might even be as well were the serious short also.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: All religions are more or less mixed with superstitions. Man is not reasonable enough to content himself with a pure and sensible religion, worthy of the Deity.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: All styles are good except the boring kind.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: All the passions die with the years; self-love alone never dies.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: All the persecutors declare against each other mortal war, while the philosopher, oppressed by them all, contents himself with pitying them.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Ancient histories, as one of our wits has said, are but fables that have been agreed upon.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Antiquity is full of the praises of another antiquity still more remote.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Books, like conversation, rarely give us any precise ideas: nothing is so common as to read and converse unprofitably. We must here repeat what Locke has so strongly urged—Define your terms.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: But nothing is more estimable than a physician who, having studied nature from his youth, knows the properties of the human body, the diseases which assail it, the remedies which will benefit it, exercises his art with caution, and pays equal attention to the rich and the poor.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Christ was baptized by John, but He Himself never baptized any one; now we profess ourselves disciples of Christ, and not of John.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Define your terms, you will permit me again to say, or we shall never understand one another.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Did anyone ever so much as think of talking geometry in good company?

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Discord is the great ill of mankind; and tolerance is the only remedy for it.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Divorce is probably of nearly the same age as marriage. I believe, however, that marriage is some weeks the more ancient.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Do not most of us resemble that old general of ninety who, having come upon some young officers debauching some girls, said to them angrily: "Gentlemen, is that the example I give you?"

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Do you think... that men have always massacred each other, as they do today? Have they always been liars, cheats, traitors, brigands, weak, flighty, cowardly, envious, gluttonous, drunken, grasping, and vicious, bloody, backbiting, debauched, fanatical, hypocritical, and silly?

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Dogs, monkeys, and parrots are a thousand times less miserable than we are.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Doubt is not a pleasant condition, but certainty is an absurd one. What is most repellent in the System of Nature [of d'Holbach] — after the recipe for making eels from flour — is the audacity with which it decides that there is no God, without even having tried to prove the impossibility.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Error flies from mouth to mouth, from pen to pen, and to destroy it takes ages.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Etymology is a science where vowels count for nothing and consonants for very little.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Even in those cities which seem to enjoy the blessings of peace, and where the arts florish, the inhabitants are devoured by envy, cares and anxieties, which are greater plagues than any experienced in a town when it is under siege.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Every abuse ought to be reformed, unless the reform is more dangerous than the abuse itself.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Faith consists in believing what reason cannot.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Fanaticism is to superstition what delirium is to fever, and fury to anger.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Fools have a habit of believing that everything written by a famous author is admirable. For my part I read only to please myself and like only what suits my taste.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: For can anything be sillier than to insist on carrying a burden one would continually much rather throw to the ground?

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Friendship is the marriage of the soul, and this marriage is liable to divorce.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: From generation to generation skepticism increases; and probability diminishes; and soon probability is reduced to zero.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: God is on the side not of the heavy battalions, but of the best shots.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: God prefers bad verses recited with a pure heart to the finest verses chanted by the wicked.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Great men have all been formed either before academies or independent of them.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: He who cannot shine by thought, seeks to bring himself into notice by a witticism.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: He who has heard the thing told by twelve thousand eyewitnesses, has only twelve thousand probabilities, equal to one strong probability, which is not equal to certainty.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: He who is involved in ecstasies and visions, who takes dreams for reality, and his own imagination for prophesy, is a fanatical novice of great hope and promise, and will soon advance to the higher stage and kill men for the love of God.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: His reputation will go on increasing because scarcely anyone reads him.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: History in general is a collection of crimes, follies, and misfortunes among which we have now and then met with a few virtues, and some happy times.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: History is the recital of facts represented as true. Fable, on the other hand, is the recital of facts represented as fiction.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: How inexpressible is the meanness of being a hypocrite! How horrible is it to be a mischievous and malignant hypocrite.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: I advise you to go on living solely to enrage those who are paying your annuities. It is the only pleasure I have left.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: I am very fond of truth, but not at all of martyrdom.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: I die adoring God, loving my friends, not hating my enemies, and detesting superstition.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: I have seen men incapable of the sciences, but never any incapable of virtue.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: I read only to please myself, and enjoy only what suits my taste.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: I read these words which are the sum of all moral philosophy, and which cut short all the disputes of the casuists: When in doubt if an action is good or bad, refrain.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: If as much care were taken to perpetuate a race of fine men as is done to prevent the mixture of ignoble blood in horses and dogs, the genealogy of every one would be written on his face and displayed in his manners.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: If one must serve, I hold it better to serve a well-bred lion, who is naturally stronger than I am, than two hundred rats of my own breed.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: If the bookseller happens to desire a privilege for his merchandise, whether he is selling Rabelais or the Fathers of the Church, the magistrate grants the privilege without answering for the contents of the book.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: If there were only one religion in England there would be danger of despotism, if there were two, they would cut each other's throats, but there are thirty, and they live in peace and happiness.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: If we do not find anything very pleasant, at least we shall find something new.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: If you want good laws, burn those you have and make new ones.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: In every province, the chief occupations, in order of importance, are lovemaking, malicious gossip, and talking nonsense.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: In the case of news, we should always wait for the sacrament of confirmation.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: In this country [England] it is useful from time to time to kill one admiral in order to encourage the others.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: In those countries where the morals are the most dissolute, the language is the most severe; as if they would replace on the lips what has deserted the heart.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: It does not depend upon us to avoid poverty, but it does depend upon us to make that poverty respected.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: It is amusing that a virtue is made of the vice of chastity; and it's a pretty odd sort of chastity at that, which leads men straight into the sin of Onan, and girls to the waning of their colour.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: It is better to risk saving a guilty person than to condemn an innocent one.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: It is clear that the individual who persecutes a man, his brother, because he is not of the same opinion, is a monster.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: It is fancy rather than taste which produces so many new fashions.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: It is far better to be silent than merely to increase the quantity of bad books.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: It is noble to write as we think; it is the privilege of humanity.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: It is not more surprising to be born twice than once; everything in nature is resurrection.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: It is strange that thought should depend upon the stomach, and still that men with the best stomachs are not always the best thinkers.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: It is very strange that men should deny a creator and yet attribute to themselves the power of creating eels.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: It is with books as with men; a very small number play a great part; the rest are lost in the multitude.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: It is with books as with the fire in our hearths; we go to a neighbor to get the embers and light it when we return home, pass it on to others, and it belongs to everyone.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: It is with history, as it is with mathematics and natural philosophy; the field of it is immensely enlarged. The more easy it is to compile newspapers, the more difficult it is at the present day to write history.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: It takes twenty years to bring man from the state of embryo, and from that of a mere animal, as he is in his first infancy, to the point when his reason begins to dawn. It has taken thirty centuries to know his structure; it would take eternity to know something of his soul: it takes but an instant to kill him.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: It would be very singular that all nature, all the planets, should obey eternal laws, and that there should be a little animal five feet high, who, in contempt of these laws, could act as he pleased, solely according to his caprice.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Laws should be clear, uniform, precise: to interpret them is nearly always to corrupt them.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Laws should never be in contradiction to usages; for, if the usages are good, the laws are valueless.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Let nature be your first physician. It is she who made all.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Let the punishments of criminals be useful. A hanged man is good for nothing; a man condemned to public works still serves the country, and is a living lesson.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Let us leave every man at liberty to seek into him and to lose himself in his ideas.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Liberty of thought is the life of the soul.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Life is long enough for him who knows how to use it. Working and thinking extend its limits.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Love has features which pierce all hearts, he wears a bandage which conceals the faults of those beloved. He has wings, he comes quickly and flies away the same.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Love is a canvas furnished by Nature, and embroidered by imagination.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Man can have only a certain number of teeth, hair and ideas; there comes a time when he necessarily loses his teeth, hair and ideas.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Man ought to be content, it is said; but with what?

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Many are destined to reason wrongly; others, not to reason at all; and others, to persecute those who do reason.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: May we not return to those scoundrels of old, the illustrious founders of superstition and fanaticism, who first took the knife from the altar to make victims of those who refused to be their disciples?

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Men use thought only to justify their wrongdoings, and speech only to conceal their thoughts.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Men will always be mad, and those who think they can cure them are the maddest of all.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Men, generally going with the stream, seldom judge for themselves, and purity of taste is almost as rare as talent.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Money is always to be found when men are to be sent to the frontiers to be destroyed: when the object is to preserve them, it is no longer so.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Morality is everywhere the same for all men, therefore it comes from God; sects differ, therefore they are the work of men.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Nothing is so common as to imitate one's enemies, and to use their weapons.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Often the prudent, far from making their destinies, succumb to them.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: One always speaks badly when one has nothing to say.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: One dies twice: to cease to live is nothing, but to cease to love and to be loved is an insupportable death.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: One must take a stand, but one should not take it at random. It is therefore necessary to our weak and blind human nature, always subject to error, to study probability with as much care as we learn arithmetic and geometry.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Opinion is called the queen of the world; it is so, for when reason opposes it, it is condemned to death. It must rise twenty times from its ashes to gradually drive away the usurper.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Our character is composed of our ideas and our feelings: and, since it has been proved that we give ourselves neither feelings nor ideas, our character does not depend on us. If it did depend on us, there is nobody who would not be perfect. If one does not reflect, one thinks oneself master of everything; but when one does reflect, one realizes that one is master of nothing.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Our wretched species is so made that those who walk on the well-trodden path always throw stones at those who are showing a new road.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Paradise was made for tender hearts; hell, for loveless hearts.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Philosophers and men of letters have done more for mankind than Orpheus, Hercules, or Theseus; for it is more meritorious and more difficult to wean men from their prejudices than to civilize the barbarian: It is harder to correct than to instruct.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Pleasantry is never good on serious points, because it always regards subjects in that point of view in which it is not the purpose to consider them.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Pleasure has its time; so, too, has wisdom. Make love in thy youth, and in old age, attend to thy salvation.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Poetry is the music of the soul, and, above all, of great and feeling souls.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Prejudice is an opinion without judgement.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Private misfortunes are public benefits; so that the more private misfortunes there are, the greater is the general good.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Quite a heavy weight, a name too quickly famous.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Reading nurtures the soul, and an enlightened friend brings it solace.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Religion may be purified. This great work was begun two hundred years ago: but men can only bear light to come in upon them by degrees.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Self-love is a balloon filled with wind, from which tempests emerge when pricked.

quotes.author: Voltaire

quotes.quote: Superstition is to religion what astrology is to astronomy, the mad daughter of a wise mother. These daughters have too long dominated the earth.

quotes.quote: The art of government consists in taking as much money as possible from one class of citizens to give to the other.

quotes.quote: The English plays are like their English puddings: nobody has any taste for them but themselves.

quotes.quote: The only reward to be expected from literature is contempt if one fails and hatred if one succeeds.

quotes.quote: The public is a ferocious beast: one must chain it up or flee from it.

quotes.quote: The rude beginnings of every art acquire a greater celebrity than the art in perfection; he who first played the fiddle was looked upon as a demigod.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: This world is but a lottery of goods, of ranks, of dignities, of rights.

quotes.quote: Those who think are excessively few; and those few do not set themselves to disturb the world.

quotes.quote: True science necessarily carries tolerance with it.

quotes.quote: Virtue between men is a commerce of good actions: he who has no part in this commerce must not be reckoned.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: Virtue debases itself in justifying itself.

quotes.author: Voltaire
quotes.quote: We adore, we invoke, we seek to appease, only that which we fear.

quotes.quote: Work saves us from three great evils: boredom, vice, and need.
